VBA MACRO ThisWorkbook.cls 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/ThisWorkbook'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Private Sub Workbook_Open()
    On Error Resume Next
    Sheets("MAIN_MENU").Activate
    Application.DisplayFullScreen = True
    saveme
    ActiveSheet.Unprotect

    Range("COOP_OVERVIEW_HEADER") = Range("COOP_NAME_SHORT") & " " & "OVERVIEW"
    Range("HOME_HEADER") = Range("COOP_NAME")
    Range("HOME_FOOTER") = Range("COOP_NAME")

    ActiveSheet.Protect
    
    ' Real-time Audit Logger App Start
    LogActivity "APP_START", "MAIN_MENU", "", "", "Workbook opened by user"
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_BeforeSave(ByVal SaveAsUI As Boolean, Cancel As Boolean)
    On Error Resume Next
    LogActivity "FILE_WRITE_SAVE", ActiveSheet.Name, "", "", "Workbook saved to disk (File Write)"
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_BeforeClose(Cancel As Boolean)
    On Error Resume Next
    Sheets("MAIN_MENU").Activate
    
    ' Real-time Audit Logger App Normal Close & Archive
    LogActivity "APP_CLOSE_NORMAL", "MAIN_MENU", "", "", "Workbook closed normally"
    ArchiveSessionLog
    
    ThisWorkbook.Save
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    On Error Resume Next
    If IsMacroRunning Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim sName As String
    sName = UCase(Sh.Name)
    
    ' Ignore internal dump / tracker / print sheets to prevent macro loop noise
    If sName = "AUDIT_TRAIL" Or InStr(sName, "DUMP") > 0 Or InStr(sName, "TRACKER") > 0 Or InStr(sName, "PRINT") > 0 Then Exit Sub
    If Target.Cells.count > 10 Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim valStr As String
    valStr = CStr(Target.Value)
    If Trim(valStr) = "" Then Exit Sub ' Ignore clearing empty cell
    If Len(valStr) > 80 Then valStr = Left(valStr, 77) & "..."
    
    LogActivity "KEY_SHEET_EDIT", Sh.Name, "", "", "Cell " & Target.Address(False, False) & " edited: " & valStr
End Sub

''/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
''/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
''////////////////PROCEDURE TO FORMAT BOX VALUES IF NEGATIVE///////////////////
''/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
''/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Public Sub Negative_Num_to_RED()
On Error Resume Next
Dim ctrl As Control      ' CREATE A CONTROL OBJECT.

For Each ctrl In Me.Controls

        If TypeName(ctrl) = "TextBox" Then
            If ctrl.Value < 0 Then
                ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
            Else
                ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
            End If
              If ctrl.Name = "note" Then ctrl.ForeColor = &HC00000

        End If
Next ctrl

End Sub

Private Sub Prnt_Report_Click()

Private Sub TB_year_drop_Change()
On Error Resume Next
If WorksheetFunction.And(TB_year_drop <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Ledger_Year_dropdown"), TB_year_drop) > 0) = True Then
        
        Range("current_year").Value = TB_year_drop.Value
                   
loadDATA
Negative_Num_to_RED

        
    Else
Dim ctrl As Control      ' CREATE A CONTROL OBJECT.
    
    For Each ctrl In Me.Controls

        If TypeName(ctrl) = "TextBox" Then
            ctrl.Value = Format(0, "#,##0.000")
        End If
    Next ctrl

Negative_Num_to_RED
       
End If

End Sub

Public Function Isloaded(formName As String)
Dim frm As Object
For Each frm In VBA.UserForms
    If frm.Name = formName Then
        Isloaded = True
        Exit Function
    End If
Next frm
Isloaded = False
End Function

Private Function Member_FullName() As String
    If WorksheetFunction.And(Ledger_from <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("reg_a1"), Ledger_from) > 0) = True Then
    
        Dim Lastname As String
        Dim Firstname As String
        Dim Middlename As String
        
        Dim Networth As Long
    
        Lastname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a3"), Ledger_from)
        Firstname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a4"), Ledger_from)
        Middlename = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a5"), Ledger_from)
        
        Member_FullName = Lastname + " " + Firstname + " " + Middlename
        
        Else
        Member_FullName = ""
    End If
End Function

Private Sub Ledger_from_Change()
If ledger_single_print_option Then
ledger_showNAME = Member_FullName
End If
End Sub

Private Sub Ledger_from_AfterUpdate()
If ledger_single_print_option = True Then
    Ledger_to = Ledger_from
    Ledger_to.Enabled = False
End If
End Sub

Private Sub ledger_multiple_print_option_Click()
ledger_showNAME = ""
Ledger_to.Enabled = True
End Sub

Private Sub ledger_single_print_option_Click()

Ledger_to = Ledger_from
Ledger_to.Enabled = False
ledger_showNAME = Member_FullName
End Sub

Private Sub Ledger_Print_Click()

If Ledger_from = vbNullString Or Ledger_from < 0 Or Ledger_from > WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1")) Then
    MsgBox "kindly input a valid registration number."
    Exit Sub
End If

Dim mm As Long
status.BackColor = RGB(0, 225, 0)
status.Caption = "Loading... Please wait..."
mm = MsgBox("This procedure will take about 30 sec to 5 Min depending on your computer.", vbOKCancel, "AUTOCOOP")
    If mm = vbOK Then
        ''DO NOTHING
        Else
        status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
        status.Caption = ""

        Exit Sub
    End If

    
    If ledger_single_print_option Then
        singlePrnt
        MsgBox "Operation Successful.", , "AUTOCOOP"
    ElseIf ledger_multiple_print_option Then
        multiplePrnt
        MsgBox "Operation Successful.", , "AUTOCOOP"
    Else
    MsgBox "Kindly select an option for 'SINGLE PRINT' of 'MULTIPLE PRINT'", , "AUTOCOOP"
    End If
status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
status.Caption = ""

End Sub
Sub singlePrnt()

Range("print_ledger") = Ledger_from

PDFLedger
End Sub
Sub multiplePrnt()
Dim x As Long
Dim m As String
Dim n As String
Dim mm As Long

mm = MsgBox("Only ACTIVE members will be printed with this option.", vbOKCancel, "AUTOCOOP")
    If mm = vbOK Then
        ''DO NOTHING
        Else
        Exit Sub
    End If
On Error Resume Next
m = Ledger_from    'InputBox("Kindly Type the First Registration You wish to print", "AUTOCOOP")

        If Ledger_from = vbNullString Or Ledger_from < 0 Or Ledger_from > WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1")) Then
            MsgBox "kindly input a valid registration number."
            Exit Sub
        End If
        
        
n = Ledger_to  'InputBox("Kindly Type the Last Registration You wish to print", "AUTOCOOP")
        If Ledger_to = vbNullString Or Ledger_to < 0 Or Ledger_to > WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1")) Then
            MsgBox "kindly input a valid registration number."
            Exit Sub
        End If

For x = m To n

    
    If WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), x) = "ACTIVE" Or WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), x) = "Active" Or WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), x) = "active" Then
    Range("Print_Ledger") = x
    BatchPDFLedger
            
    End If
Next x

'confirmation message
MsgBox "PDF files has been created successfully", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"

End Sub

Private Sub Schedule_Print_Click()
    Sheets("schedule_prnt").Rows("5:1000000").Delete
    Sheets("schedule_prnt").Rows("4:4").ClearContents          'Reset Sheet for new entry    Selection.ClearContents     '
    
Dim mm As Long
status.BackColor = RGB(0, 225, 0)
status.Caption = "Loading... Please wait..."
mm = MsgBox("This procedure will take about 30 sec to 5 Min depending on your computer.", vbOKCancel, "AUTOCOOP")
    If mm = vbOK Then
        ''DO NOTHING
        Else
        status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
        status.Caption = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    
    
    'Validate Year Channel
            If Pyear <> "" And WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Ledger_Year_dropdown"), Pyear) > 0 Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Selected Year is Invalid.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If

    'Validate Month Channel
            If PMonth <> "" And PMonth = "January" _
            Or PMonth = "February" _
            Or PMonth = "March" _
            Or PMonth = "April" _
            Or PMonth = "May" _
            Or PMonth = "June" _
            Or PMonth = "July" _
            Or PMonth = "August" _
            Or PMonth = "September" _
            Or PMonth = "October" _
            Or PMonth = "November" _
            Or PMonth = "December" Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Selected Month is Invalid.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If


If Schedule_DR_option Then
Range("schedule_header") = "MONTHLY SCHEDULE FOR THE MONTH OF " & PMonth & " (Debit Transactions)"
Range("sdl_detail") = "Debit"
Else
Range("schedule_header") = "MONTHLY SCHEDULE FOR THE MONTH OF " & PMonth & " (Credit Transactions)"
Range("sdl_detail") = "Credit"
End If

Range("sdl_month") = PMonth
Range("sdl_year") = Pyear

Call schedule_header
If Schedule_CR_option Then positive_data_drop
If Schedule_DR_option Then negative_data_drop

Call sumschedule
Range("Prnt_Schedule").Columns.AutoFit
Call PDFSchedule

    Sheets("schedule_prnt").Rows("5:1000000").Delete
    Sheets("schedule_prnt").Rows("4:4").ClearContents          'Reset Sheet for new entry    Selection.ClearContents     '

status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
status.Caption = ""

MsgBox "Operation Successful.", , "AUTOCOOP"

End Sub

'check if member made payment this month THEN DROP THE REG NUMBER IF POSITIVE

            Range("rem_a3"), i, _

Private Function sdl_selected_date() As Date

Dim q As Long
Dim selyear As Long

selyear = Pyear

If PMonth = "January" Then q = 1
If PMonth = "February" Then q = 2
If PMonth = "March" Then q = 3
If PMonth = "April" Then q = 4
If PMonth = "May" Then q = 5
If PMonth = "June" Then q = 6
If PMonth = "July" Then q = 7
If PMonth = "August" Then q = 8
If PMonth = "September" Then q = 9
If PMonth = "October" Then q = 10
If PMonth = "November" Then q = 11
If PMonth = "December" Then q = 12

sdl_selected_date = DateSerial(selyear, q, 1)

End Function

Private Function RMT_selected_date() As Date

Dim q As Long
Dim selyear As Long

selyear = Rmt_year

q = Month(month_1)

RMT_selected_date = DateSerial(selyear, q, 1)

End Function

Private Sub Rmt_Print_Click()
Sheets("Remittance_prnt").Rows("5:1000000").Delete
Sheets("Remittance_prnt").Rows("4:4").ClearContents          'Reset Sheet for new entry    Selection.ClearContents     '

Dim mm As Long
status.BackColor = RGB(0, 225, 0)
status.Caption = "Loading... Please wait..."
mm = MsgBox("This procedure will take about 30 sec to 5 Min depending on your computer.", vbOKCancel, "AUTOCOOP")
    If mm = vbOK Then
        ''DO NOTHING
        Else
        status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
        status.Caption = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    
    
    'Validate Year Channel
            If Rmt_year <> "" And WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Ledger_Year_dropdown"), Rmt_year) > 0 Then
            Range("CURRENT_YEAR") = Rmt_year
            Else
            MsgBox "Selected Year is Invalid.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If



If Rmt_DR Then
Range("Remit_header") = "REMITTANCE RECORD FOR " & Rmt_year & " FINANCIAL YEAR (Debit Transactions)"
Range("Remit_Details") = "Debit"
Else
Range("Remit_header") = "REMITTANCE RECORD FOR " & Rmt_year & " FINANCIAL YEAR (Credit Transactions)"
Range("Remit_Details") = "Credit"
End If

Range("Remit_year") = Rmt_year

Call Remit_header

If Rmt_CR Then positive_RMT_data_drop
If Rmt_DR Then negative_RMT_data_drop

Call sumremittance
Range("Prnt_remittance").Columns.AutoFit

Call PDFremittance


Sheets("Remittance_prnt").Rows("5:1000000").Delete
Sheets("Remittance_prnt").Rows("4:4").ClearContents          'Reset Sheet for new entry    Selection.ClearContents     '

status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
status.Caption = ""

MsgBox "Operation Successful.", , "AUTOCOOP"


End Sub

Sub positive_RMT_data_drop()

Dim a1 As Range

Set a1 = Range("rem_a4")

Dim mnt1 As Date
Dim mnt2 As Date
Dim mnt3 As Date
Dim mnt4 As Date
Dim mnt5 As Date
Dim mnt6 As Date
Dim mnt7 As Date
Dim mnt8 As Date
Dim mnt9 As Date
Dim mnt10 As Date
Dim mnt11 As Date
Dim mnt12 As Date

mnt1 = month_1
mnt2 = month_2
mnt3 = month_3
mnt4 = month_4
mnt5 = month_5
mnt6 = month_6
mnt7 = month_7
mnt8 = month_8
mnt9 = month_9
mnt10 = month_10
mnt11 = month_11
mnt12 = month_12

Dim r As Long
Dim m As Long
Dim i As Long
Dim remtotal As Range
Dim bank_date As Range
Dim bank_det_date As Range
Dim rgnumber_det As Range
Dim x As Double

m = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1")) 'max registration number
Set remtotal = Range("rem_a4")
Set rgnumber_det = Range("rem_a3")

Set bank_date = Range("rem_a2")
Set bank_det_date = Range("rem_a2")

For i = 1 To m
    r = WorksheetFunction.count(Range("Remit_1")) + 1 ' next available row
'check if member made payment this year THEN DROP THE REG NUMBER IF POSITIVE
        If Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(remtotal, _
            rgnumber_det, i, _
            remtotal, ">0", _
            Range("rem_a5"), "<>" & "Internal transfer", _
            bank_date, ">=" & RMT_selected_date, _
            bank_date, "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(RMT_selected_date, 11)) > 0 Or _
            WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), i) = "ACTIVE" Or WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), i) = "Active" Or WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), i) = "active" Then

            Range("Remit_2").Cells(r) = i
        Else
            GoTo nextno
        End If

    Range("Remit_1").Cells(r) = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("Remit_1")) + 1   ' Calculate the next serial number


    Range("Remit_3").Cells(r) = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(a1, _
            rgnumber_det, i, _
            a1, ">0", _
            Range("rem_a5"), "<>" & "Internal transfer", _
            bank_det_date, ">=" & mnt1, _
            bank_det_date, "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(mnt1, 0)), "#,##0.000")

    Range("Remit_4").Cells(r) = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(a1, _

    Range("Remit_6").Cells(r) = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(a1, _

Private Sub Members_Print_Click()
Sheets("Member_list").Rows("5:1000000").Delete
Sheets("Member_list").Rows("4:4").ClearContents          'Reset Sheet for new entry    Selection.ClearContents     '

Dim mm As Long
status.BackColor = RGB(0, 225, 0)
status.Caption = "Loading... Please wait..."
mm = MsgBox("This procedure will take about 30 sec to 5 Min depending on your computer.", vbOKCancel, "AUTOCOOP")
    If mm = vbOK Then
        ''DO NOTHING
        Else
        status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
        status.Caption = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If


Range("now_month") = Format(Now(), "MMMM")


If members Then Range("mem_header") = "ACTIVE MEMBER LIST  AS AT  " & Range("now_month") & " " & Format(Now(), "YYYY")
If AllMembers Then Range("mem_header") = "FULL MEMBER LIST(ACTIVE & CLOSED)  AS AT  " & Range("now_month") & " " & Format(Now(), "YYYY")

If nonmembers Then Range("mem_header") = "ACTIVE NON-MEMBER LIST  AS AT  " & Range("now_month") & " " & Format(Now(), "YYYY")
If AllnonMembers Then Range("mem_header") = "FULL NON-MEMBER LIST(ACTIVE & INACTIVE) AS AT  " & Range("now_month") & " " & Format(Now(), "YYYY")

Call Mem_prnt_header

If members Or AllMembers Then PRINT_MEMBRES_list
If nonmembers Or AllnonMembers Then PRINT_nonMEMBRES_list


'format page for printing///////////////////////////
Range("mem_lstLprt_1").Columns.AutoFit
Range("mem_lstLprt_2").Columns.AutoFit
Range("mem_lstLprt_2").HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
Range("mem_lstLprt_3").ColumnWidth = 38
Range("mem_lstLprt_4").Columns.AutoFit
Range("mem_lstLprt_5").ColumnWidth = 17
Range("mem_lstLprt_6").ColumnWidth = 17
Range("mem_lstLprt_7").ColumnWidth = 17

Call PDFmemberList

''Sheets("Member_list").Rows("5:1000000").Delete
''Sheets("Member_list").Rows("4:4").ClearContents          'Reset Sheet for new entry    Selection.ClearContents     '

        status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
        status.Caption = ""
MsgBox "Operation Successful.", , "AUTOCOOP"

End Sub

Range("mem_lstLprt_1").Offset(-1, 0) = "S/N"

Range("mem_lstLprt_6").Offset(-1, 0) = mem_list_opt2.Caption
Range("mem_lstLprt_7").Offset(-1, 0) = mem_list_opt3.Caption
End Sub

Sub PRINT_MEMBRES_list()

Dim r As Long
Dim m As Long
Dim i As Long
Dim namelist As Range
Dim Mobilelist As Range
Dim rgstatusLIST As Range

m = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1")) 'max registration number
Set namelist = Range("reg_a30")
Set Mobilelist = Range("reg_a8")
Set rgstatusLIST = Range("reg_a2")

For i = 1 To m
    r = WorksheetFunction.count(Range("mem_lstLprt_1")) + 1 ' next available row
'check if member is active or not

If members Then
    If WorksheetFunction.Index(rgstatusLIST, i) = "ACTIVE" Or WorksheetFunction.Index(rgstatusLIST, i) = "Active" Or WorksheetFunction.Index(rgstatusLIST, i) = "active" Then
            Range("mem_lstLprt_2").Cells(r) = i
    Else
            GoTo nextno
    End If
Else
    Range("mem_lstLprt_2").Cells(r) = i
End If
            
Range("mem_lstLprt_1").Cells(r) = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("mem_lstLprt_1")) + 1   ' Calculate the next serial number
Range("mem_lstLprt_3").Cells(r) = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(namelist, i)
Range("mem_lstLprt_4").Cells(r) = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Mobilelist, i)

nextno:
Next i
End Sub

Sub PRINT_nonMEMBRES_list()
'On Error Resume Next
Dim r As Long
Dim m As Long
Dim i As Long
Dim namelist As Range
Dim Mobilelist As Range
Dim rgstatusLIST As Range

m = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("xreg_a1")) 'max registration number
Set namelist = Range("xreg_a30")
Set Mobilelist = Range("xreg_a8")
Set rgstatusLIST = Range("xreg_a2")

For i = 1 To m
    r = WorksheetFunction.count(Range("mem_lstLprt_1")) + 1 ' next available row
'check if member is active or not

If nonmembers Then
    If WorksheetFunction.Index(rgstatusLIST, i) = "ACTIVE" Or WorksheetFunction.Index(rgstatusLIST, i) = "Active" Or WorksheetFunction.Index(rgstatusLIST, i) = "active" Then
            Range("mem_lstLprt_2").Cells(r) = i
    Else
            GoTo nextno
    End If
Else
    Range("mem_lstLprt_2").Cells(r) = i
End If
            
Range("mem_lstLprt_1").Cells(r) = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("mem_lstLprt_1")) + 1   ' Calculate the next serial number
Range("mem_lstLprt_3").Cells(r) = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(namelist, i)
Range("mem_lstLprt_4").Cells(r) = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Mobilelist, i)

nextno:
Next i
End Sub

Private Sub Unclaimed_Print_Click()
    Sheets("Unclaimed_prnt").Rows("5:1000000").Delete
    Sheets("Unclaimed_prnt").Rows("4:4").ClearContents          'Reset Sheet for new entry    Selection.ClearContents     '
    
Dim mm As Long
status.BackColor = RGB(0, 225, 0)
status.Caption = "Loading... Please wait..."
mm = MsgBox("This procedure will take about 30 sec to 5 Min depending on your computer.", vbOKCancel, "AUTOCOOP")
    If mm = vbOK Then
        ''DO NOTHING
        Else
        status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
        status.Caption = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    
    'Validate Year Channel
            If Unclaimed_year <> "" And WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Ledger_Year_dropdown"), Pyear) > 0 Or Unclaimed_year = "All" Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Selected Year is Invalid.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If

    'Validate Month Channel
            If unclaimed_mnth <> "" And unclaimed_mnth = "January" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "All" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "February" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "March" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "April" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "May" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "June" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "July" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "August" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "September" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "October" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "November" _
            Or unclaimed_mnth = "December" Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Selected Month is Invalid.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If



Range("UNCMonth") = unclaimed_mnth
Range("UNCyear") = Unclaimed_year

If unclaimed Then
    If unclaimed_mnth = "All" Then
    Range("unclaimed_header") = "UNCLAIMED PAYMENTS FOR THE YEAR " & Range("UNCyear")
    Else
    Range("unclaimed_header") = "UNCLAIMED PAYMENTS FOR THE MONTH OF " & Range("UNCMonth")
    End If
Else
    If unclaimed_mnth = "All" Then
    Range("unclaimed_header") = "TOTAL UNCLAIMED PAYMENTS FOR THE YEAR " & Range("UNCyear")
    Else
    Range("unclaimed_header") = "TOTAL UNCLAIMED PAYMENTS FOR THE MONTH OF " & Range("UNCMonth")
    End If
End If

Call unclaimed_header
'If unclaimed_all Then TOTunclamed
If unclaimed Then BALunclamed

Call sumUNCLAIMED


Range("Prnt_Schedule").Columns.AutoFit
Range("uncl_a3").ColumnWidth = 11
Range("uncl_a4").Columns.AutoFit
Range("uncl_a7").ColumnWidth = 35
Range("uncl_a7").WrapText = True
Range("Prnt_Schedule").EntireRow.AutoFit


Call PDFunclaimed

status.BackColor = &HFFFFFF
status.Caption = ""

MsgBox "Operation Successful.", , "AUTOCOOP"

End Sub


Sub unclaimed_header()

Range("shdl_1").Offset(-1, 0) = "S/N"
Range("shdl_2").Offset(-1, 0) = "Tran. ID"
Range("shdl_3").Offset(-1, 0) = "Reg. No."
Range("shdl_4").Offset(-1, 0) = "Amount"
Range("shdl_5").Offset(-1, 0) = "Channel"
Range("shdl_6").Offset(-1, 0) = "Description"
Range("shdl_7").Offset(-1, 0) = "Details"
Range("uncl_date").Offset(-1, 0) = "Date"

End Sub
Sub BALunclamed()

Dim a1 As Range
Dim a2 As Range
Dim a3 As Range
Dim a4 As Range
Dim a5 As Range
Dim a6 As Range
Dim a7 As Range

Set a1 = Range("rem_a1")
Set a2 = Range("rem_a2")
Set a3 = Range("rem_a3")
Set a4 = Range("rem_a4")
Set a5 = Range("rem_a5")
Set a6 = Range("rem_a6")
Set a7 = Range("rem_a7")

Dim r As Long
Dim m As Long
Dim i As Long
Dim Rem_reg_no As Range
Dim Rem_Amt As Range
Dim Rem_Channl As Range
Dim Rem_Desc As Range
Dim Rem_Details As Range
Dim Rem_Date As Range
'Dim x As Double

m = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("rem_a1")) 'max registration number
Set Rem_reg_no = Range("rem_a3")
Set Rem_Amt = Range("rem_a4")
Set Rem_Channl = Range("rem_a5")
Set Rem_Desc = Range("rem_a6")
Set Rem_Details = Range("rem_a7")
Set Rem_Date = Range("rem_a2")

For i = 1 To m

    r = WorksheetFunction.count(Range("uncl_a1")) + 1 ' next available row





'check if transaction is UNCLAIMED

If unclaimed And unclaimed_mnth = "All" Then
    If WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_reg_no, i) = "B" Then
            Range("uncl_a2").Cells(r) = i
        Else
            GoTo nextno
    End If
    
    
ElseIf unclaimed And unclaimed_mnth <> "All" Then
    If WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_reg_no, i) = "B" And WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_Date, i) >= unclaimedDATE And WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_Date, i) <= WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(unclaimedDATE, 0) Then
            Range("uncl_a2").Cells(r) = i
        Else
            GoTo nextno
    End If
    
End If









    Range("uncl_a1").Cells(r) = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("uncl_a1")) + 1   ' Calculate the next serial number

    Range("uncl_a3").Cells(r) = ""
    Range("uncl_a4").Cells(r) = Format(WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_Amt, i), "#,##0.000")
    Range("uncl_a5").Cells(r) = WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_Channl, i)
    Range("uncl_a6").Cells(r) = WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_Desc, i)
    Range("uncl_a7").Cells(r) = WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_Details, i)
    Range("uncl_date").Cells(r) = Format(WorksheetFunction.Index(Rem_Date, i), "dd mmm, yyyy")

nextno:
Next i

End Sub
Private Function unclaimedDATE() As Date
                    Dim q As Long
                    Dim selyear As Long
        
                    selyear = Unclaimed_year
                    
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "January" Then q = 1
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "February" Then q = 2
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "March" Then q = 3
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "April" Then q = 4
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "May" Then q = 5
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "June" Then q = 6
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "July" Then q = 7
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "August" Then q = 8
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "September" Then q = 9
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "October" Then q = 10
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "November" Then q = 11
                    If unclaimed_mnth = "December" Then q = 12
                    unclaimedDATE = DateSerial(selyear, q, 1)
End Function
Sub sumUNCLAIMED()

Dim r As Long
    r = WorksheetFunction.count(Range("uncl_a1")) + 1 ' next available row

Range("uncl_a1").Cells(r) = "TOTAL"
Range("uncl_a4").Cells(r) = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(Range("uncl_a4")), "#,##0.000")

End Sub

Private Sub unclaimed_mnth_change()
On Error Resume Next
If unclaimed_mnth = "All" Then

count_all_unclaimed = WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_a3"), "B", _
                        Range("rem_a2"), ">=" & DateSerial(Unclaimed_year, Month(month_1), 1), _
                        Range("rem_a2"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(DateSerial(Unclaimed_year, Month(month_1), 1), 11)) _
                        & " Record found."
total_all_unclaimed = "Total: " & Format(WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_a4"), Range("rem_a3"), "B", _
                        Range("rem_a2"), ">=" & DateSerial(Unclaimed_year, Month(month_1), 1), _
                        Range("rem_a2"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(DateSerial(Unclaimed_year, Month(month_1), 1), 11)), "#,##0.000")
Else
count_all_unclaimed = WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_a3"), "B", _
                        Range("rem_a2"), ">=" & unclaimedDATE, _
                        Range("rem_a2"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(unclaimedDATE, 0)) _
                        & " Record found."
total_all_unclaimed = "Total: " & Format(WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_a4"), Range("rem_a3"), "B", _
                        Range("rem_a2"), ">=" & unclaimedDATE, _
                        Range("rem_a2"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(unclaimedDATE, 0)), "#,##0.000")

End If
End Sub

Private Sub Unclaimed_year_Change()
On Error Resume Next
If unclaimed_mnth = "All" Then

count_all_unclaimed = WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_a3"), "B", _
                        Range("rem_a2"), ">=" & DateSerial(Unclaimed_year, Month(month_1), 1), _
                        Range("rem_a2"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(DateSerial(Unclaimed_year, Month(month_1), 1), 11)) _
                        & " Record found."
total_all_unclaimed = "Total: " & Format(WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_a4"), Range("rem_a3"), "B", _
                        Range("rem_a2"), ">=" & DateSerial(Unclaimed_year, Month(month_1), 1), _
                        Range("rem_a2"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(DateSerial(Unclaimed_year, Month(month_1), 1), 11)), "#,##0.000")
Else
count_all_unclaimed = WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_a3"), "B", _
                        Range("rem_a2"), ">=" & unclaimedDATE, _
                        Range("rem_a2"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(unclaimedDATE, 0)) _
                        & " Record found."
total_all_unclaimed = "Total: " & Format(WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_a4"), Range("rem_a3"), "B", _
                        Range("rem_a2"), ">=" & unclaimedDATE, _
                        Range("rem_a2"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(unclaimedDATE, 0)), "#,##0.000")

End If

End Sub

Private Sub Advise_Reg_No_Change()

On Error GoTo errHandler

If Advise_Reg_No = "" Then Exit Sub

If WorksheetFunction.And(Advise_Reg_No <> "", Advise_Reg_No = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1")) + 1) = True Then Exit Sub

If WorksheetFunction.And(Advise_Reg_No <> "", Advise_Reg_No > Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1")) + 1) = True Then Advise_Reg_No = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1"))   'Or Advise_Reg_No = 0

If WorksheetFunction.And(Advise_Reg_No <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("reg_a1"), Advise_Reg_No) > 0) = True Then

        Dim MEMname As String

        MEMname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a30"), Advise_Reg_No)

        Me.Caption = "AUTOCOOP                               " + MEMname

        Else

            If WorksheetFunction.And(Advise_Reg_No <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("reg_a1"), Advise_Reg_No) + 1 = 1) = True Then

                Me.Caption = "AUTOCOOP                   New Member Advise log"

            Else

            Advise_Reg_No = 1

            End If

End If

adviseME

exitHandler:

    Exit Sub

errHandler:

    Resume exitHandler

End Sub

    End If

    '- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -- - - -

    CA1.Value = Format(CA1, "#,##0.000")

    CA_Total.Caption = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(CA1, CA2, CA3, CA4, CA5, CA6, CA7, CA8, CA9, CA10, CA11, CA12, CA13, CA14, CA15, CA16, CA17, CA18, CA19, CA20, CA21, CA22, CA23, CA24, CA25), "#,##0.000")

exitme:

Exit Sub

err:

Resume exitme

End Sub

Private Sub NextRecord_Click()

On Error Resume Next

Dim i As Long

Dim y As Long

Dim n As Long

n = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1"))

y = Advise_Reg_No.Value + 1

For i = y To n

        If WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), i) = "ACTIVE" Then

        Advise_Reg_No = i

        Exit Sub

        Else

        GoTo nnex

        End If

nnex:

Next i

End Sub

Private Sub PrevRecord_Click()

Dim x As Long

x = Advise_Reg_No.Value - 1

If x = 0 Then Advise_Reg_No.Value = 1 Else Advise_Reg_No.Value = x

End Sub

Private Sub LastRecord_Click()

Advise_Reg_No.Value = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1"))

End Sub

Private Sub FirstRecord_Click()

Advise_Reg_No.Value = WorksheetFunction.Min(Range("reg_a1"))

End Sub

Function advise_live1() As Long ' ADVISE CALCULATION

On Error Resume Next

Dim cur_bal As Long

Dim raw_adv As Long

Dim reg_No As Long

' THE FOLLOWING CODE WILL CALCULATE ADVISE FOR ENTERPRISE 1 (registration Form)

cur_bal = CB1.Value

reg_No = Advise_Reg_No.Value

advise_live1 = IIf(cur_bal < 0, cur_bal * -1, 0)

End Function

Function advise_live15() As Long ' ADVISE CALCULATION (Accrued Profit capped at 6-month clearance)
On Error Resume Next
Dim cur_bal As Double, raw_adv As Double, reg_No As Long, repay_cnt As Long, rem_m As Long, profit_adv As Double
cur_bal = CB15.Value
reg_No = Advise_Reg_No.Value
raw_adv = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("adv_a16"), reg_No)
If cur_bal >= 0 Then
    advise_live15 = 0
Else
    repay_cnt = Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_det_a2"), reg_No, Range("rem_det_a17"), ">0")
    rem_m = 6 - repay_cnt
    If rem_m < 1 Then rem_m = 1
    profit_adv = WorksheetFunction.RoundUp((cur_bal * -1) / rem_m, 0)
    If profit_adv > (cur_bal * -1) Then profit_adv = cur_bal * -1
    advise_live15 = profit_adv
End If
End Function

Function advise_live16() As Long ' ADVISE CALCULATION

On Error Resume Next

Dim cur_bal As Long

Dim raw_adv As Long

Dim reg_No As Long

' THE FOLLOWING CODE WILL CALCULATE ADVISE FOR ENTERPRISE 8 (UTILITY)

cur_bal = CB16.Value

reg_No = Advise_Reg_No.Value

raw_adv = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("adv_a17"), reg_No)

advise_live16 = IIf(raw_adv * -1 < cur_bal, cur_bal * -1, raw_adv)

End Function

Function advise_live17() As Long ' ADVISE CALCULATION

On Error Resume Next

Dim cur_bal As Long

Dim raw_adv As Long

Dim exp_bal As Long

Dim reg_No As Long

Dim curr_mnt_bal As Long

' THE FOLLOWING CODE WILL CALCULATE ADVISE FOR ENTERPRISE 17 (COOP DUES)

cur_bal = CB17.Value

reg_No = Advise_Reg_No.Value

raw_adv = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("adv_a18"), reg_No)

exp_bal = Range("Expexted_Bal_1")

curr_mnt_bal = Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a19"), Range("rem_det_a19"), ">0", Range("rem_det_a30"), ">=" & currently, Range("rem_det_a30"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(currently, 0))

advise_live17 = IIf(curr_mnt_bal > 0, 0, IIf(cur_bal < exp_bal, (-1 * cur_bal) - (exp_bal * -1) + raw_adv, IIf(cur_bal > raw_adv * -1, cur_bal * -1, raw_adv)))

End Function

Sheets("MAIN_MENU").Activate
Application.DisplayFullScreen = True
saveme
ActiveSheet.Unprotect
Range("COOP_OVERVIEW_HEADER") = Range("COOP_NAME_SHORT") & " " & "OVERVIEW"

allocate_LOAN_Intrest

ActiveSheet.Protect

End Sub

    PrintPage_PageSetup

Private Function Member_FullName() As String

   On Error Resume Next

    If WorksheetFunction.And(Ledger_reg_No <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("reg_a1"), Ledger_reg_No) > 0) = True Then

        Member_FullName = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a30"), Ledger_reg_No)

        Else

        Member_FullName = ""

    End If

End Function

Private Function Member_Mobile() As String

   On Error Resume Next

    If WorksheetFunction.And(Ledger_reg_No <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("reg_a1"), Ledger_reg_No) > 0) = True Then

        Member_Mobile = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a8"), Ledger_reg_No)

        Else

        Member_Mobile = ""

    End If

End Function

Private Function Member_Status() As String

   On Error Resume Next

    If WorksheetFunction.And(Ledger_reg_No <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("reg_a1"), Ledger_reg_No) > 0) = True Then

        Member_Status = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), Ledger_reg_No)

        Else

        Member_Status = ""

    End If

End Function

Private Function Member_Networth() As Double

   On Error Resume Next

    If WorksheetFunction.And(Ledger_reg_No <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("reg_a1"), Ledger_reg_No) > 0) = True Then

        Dim a As Double, b As Double, c As Double, d As Double, e As Double, f As Double, g As Double, h As Double, i As Double, j As Double, k As Double, l As Double, m As Double, n As Double, o As Double, p As Double, q As Double, r As Double, s As Double, t As Double, u As Double, v As Double, w As Double, x As Double, y As Double

            a = YEAR_BAL1

            b = YEAR_BAL2

            c = YEAR_BAL3

            d = YEAR_BAL4

            e = YEAR_BAL5

            f = YEAR_BAL6

            g = YEAR_BAL7

            h = YEAR_BAL8

            i = YEAR_BAL9

            j = YEAR_BAL10

            k = YEAR_BAL11

            l = YEAR_BAL12

            m = YEAR_BAL13

            n = YEAR_BAL14

            o = YEAR_BAL15

            p = YEAR_BAL16

            q = YEAR_BAL17

            r = YEAR_BAL18

            s = YEAR_BAL19

            t = YEAR_BAL20

            u = YEAR_BAL21

            v = YEAR_BAL22

            w = YEAR_BAL23

            x = YEAR_BAL24

            y = YEAR_BAL25

            Member_Networth = a + b + c + d + e + f + g + h + i + j + k + l + m + n + o + p + q + r + s + t + u + v + w + x + y

        Else

            Member_Networth = 0#

    End If

End Function

Private Sub Negative_Num_to_RED()

On Error Resume Next

Dim ctrl As Control      ' CREATE A CONTROL OBJECT.

For Each ctrl In Me.Controls

        If TypeName(ctrl) = "TextBox" Then

            If ctrl.Value < 0 Then

                ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)

            Else

                ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)

            End If

        End If

Next ctrl

End Sub

Private Sub NextRecord_Click()

On Error Resume Next

Dim i As Long

Dim y As Long

Dim n As Long

n = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1"))

y = Ledger_reg_No.Value + 1

For i = y To n

    If WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), i) = "ACTIVE" Then

            Ledger_reg_No = i

    Exit Sub

    End If

Next i

End Sub

Private Sub PrevRecord_Click()

On Error Resume Next

Dim x As Long

x = Ledger_reg_No.Value - 1

If x = 0 Then Ledger_reg_No.Value = 1 Else Ledger_reg_No.Value = x

End Sub

Private Sub LastRecord_Click()

On Error Resume Next

Ledger_reg_No.Value = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1"))

End Sub

Private Sub FirstRecord_Click()

On Error Resume Next

Ledger_reg_No.Value = WorksheetFunction.Min(Range("reg_a1"))

End Sub

Private Sub Ledger_year_drop_Change()

On Error Resume Next

If WorksheetFunction.And(Ledger_year_drop <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Ledger_Year_dropdown"), Ledger_year_drop) > 0) = True Then

        Range("current_year").Value = Ledger_year_drop.Value

        month1.Caption = Format(month_1, "MMMM YYYY")

        month2.Caption = Format(month_2, "MMMM YYYY")

        month3.Caption = Format(month_3, "MMMM YYYY")

        month4.Caption = Format(month_4, "MMMM YYYY")

        month5.Caption = Format(month_5, "MMMM YYYY")

        month6.Caption = Format(month_6, "MMMM YYYY")

        month7.Caption = Format(month_7, "MMMM YYYY")

        month8.Caption = Format(month_8, "MMMM YYYY")

        month9.Caption = Format(month_9, "MMMM YYYY")

        month10.Caption = Format(month_10, "MMMM YYYY")

        month11.Caption = Format(month_11, "MMMM YYYY")

        month12.Caption = Format(month_12, "MMMM YYYY")

        MY_YEAR.Value = Range("current_year")

        MY_MONTH.Value = Format(WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("Months_of_the_year"), 1), "m")

        Call Refresh

        Call Refresh2

    Else

        Exit Sub

End If

End Sub

Sub payment_indicatior()

On Error Resume Next

    If amount_paid_1 = 0 And Now() > WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(month_1, 0) Then

        month1.BackColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)

        ElseIf amount_paid_1 > 0 And Now() > WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(month_1, 0) Then

        month1.BackColor = RGB(0, 255, 0)

        Else: month1.BackColor = &H8000000F

    End If

    If amount_paid_2 = 0 And Now() > WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(month_2, 0) Then

        month2.BackColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)

        ElseIf amount_paid_2 > 0 And Now() > WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(month_2, 0) Then

        month2.BackColor = RGB(0, 255, 0)

        Else: month2.BackColor = &H8000000F

    End If

Private Function ActiveLoan_ID_1() As Long

On Error Resume Next

Dim ID_count_1 As Long

ID_count_1 = Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_det_a12"), "<0", Range("rem_det_a31"), "Open", Range("rem_det_a2"), Ledger_reg_No)

If ID_count_1 > 1 Then

    ActiveLoan_ID_1 = 1

ElseIf ID_count_1 = 1 Then

    ActiveLoan_ID_1 = Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a1"), Range("rem_det_a12"), "<0", Range("rem_det_a2"), Ledger_reg_No, Range("rem_det_a31"), "Open")

Else

    ActiveLoan_ID_1 = 0

End If

End Function

Function Rmark_1() As String

On Error Resume Next

  '  RETURNS REMARK OF ACTIVE LOAN

  Dim cur_bal As Double

  Dim exp_bal As Double

  Dim dtdiff As Double

  Dim monthly_payable As Double

  Dim amount_col As Double

  Dim loan_duration As Double

  Dim start_dat As Date

  Dim End_dat As Date

  Dim ActivLoan_end1

If ActiveLoan_ID_1 > 1 Then

    ActivLoan_end1 = Application.WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(ActiveLoan_SD_1, ActiveLoan_DURATION_1)

    amount_col = Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a12"), Range("rem_det_a2"), Ledger_reg_No, Range("rem_det_a31"), "Open")

    loan_duration = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("rem_det_a32"), ActiveLoan_ID_1)

    cur_bal = Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a12"), Range("rem_det_a2"), Ledger_reg_No)

    start_dat = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("rem_det_a30"), ActiveLoan_ID_1)

    End_dat = Application.WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(start_dat, loan_duration)

    monthly_payable = amount_col / loan_duration

    dtdiff = DateDiff("m", start_dat, Now())

    exp_bal = amount_col - (monthly_payable * dtdiff)

    If Now() > ActivLoan_end1 Then

        Rmark_1 = "Outright Default"

    ElseIf cur_bal >= exp_bal Then

        Rmark_1 = "Good Standing"

    ElseIf cur_bal < exp_bal Then

        Rmark_1 = "Partial Default"

    Else

    End If

ElseIf ActiveLoan_ID_1 = 1 Then

    Rmark_1 = "Multi Loan"

Else

    Rmark_1 = "No Loan"

End If

End Function

Sub CHECKSAV_SHAR()

'''''''''''''CHECK SAVINGS:SHARE RATIO YEAR BALANCE'''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

'''''''''''''CHECK SAVINGS:SHARE RATIO YEAR BALANCE''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

   Dim x As Double  ' total current shares

   Dim y As Double  ' total current savings

   Dim x2 As Double  ' current year shares

   Dim y2 As Double  ' Current year savings

   Dim x3 As Double  ' total current month shares

   Dim y3 As Double  ' total current month savings

   Dim x4 As Double  ' current month shares

   Dim y4 As Double  ' Current month savings

   x = Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a6"), Range("rem_det_a2"), Ledger_reg_No, Range("rem_det_a30"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(startyear, 11))

   y = Range("LOAN_SHARE").Value / 100 * Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a5"), Range("rem_det_a2"), Ledger_reg_No, Range("rem_det_a30"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(startyear, 11))

   x2 = YR_CR_0004

   y2 = Range("LOAN_SHARE").Value / 100 * YR_CR_0003

   x3 = MN_BAL_004

   y3 = Range("LOAN_SHARE").Value / 100 * MN_BAL_003

   x4 = MN_CR_004

   y4 = Range("LOAN_SHARE").Value / 100 * MN_CR_003

    If x < y Then

    YR_BAL_0004.BackColor = RGB(255, 20, 0)

    Else

    YR_BAL_0004.BackColor = RGB(0, 250, 0)

    End If

    If x2 < y2 Then

    YR_CR_0004.BackColor = RGB(255, 20, 0)

    Else

    YR_CR_0004.BackColor = RGB(0, 250, 0)

    End If

    If x3 < y3 Then

    MN_BAL_004.BackColor = RGB(255, 20, 0)

    Else

    MN_BAL_004.BackColor = RGB(0, 250, 0)

    End If

    If x4 < y4 Then

    MN_CR_004.BackColor = RGB(255, 20, 0)

    Else

    MN_CR_004.BackColor = RGB(0, 250, 0)

    End If

'''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

'''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

End Sub

Private Sub Ledger_reg_No_Change()
    If WorksheetFunction.And(Ledger_reg_No <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("xreg_a1"), Ledger_reg_No) > 0) = True Then
    
        Dim Lastname As String
        Dim Firstname As String
        Dim Middlename As String
        
        Lastname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a3"), Ledger_reg_No)
        Firstname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a4"), Ledger_reg_No)
        Middlename = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a5"), Ledger_reg_No)

    
        my_full_name.Caption = Lastname + " " + Firstname + " " + Middlename
        my_mobile_num.Caption = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a8"), Ledger_reg_No)
        my_bmobile_num.Caption = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a14"), Ledger_reg_No)
        my_Buss_Name.Caption = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a13"), Ledger_reg_No)
        Else
        my_full_name.Caption = ""
        my_mobile_num = ""
        my_Buss_Name.Caption = ""
        my_bmobile_num.Caption = ""
    End If



reload_DR_CR_and_BAL
Remittance_Lookup
totals_calculations
End Sub

Private Sub Ledger_year_drop_Change()

If WorksheetFunction.And(Ledger_year_drop <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Ledger_Year_dropdown"), Ledger_year_drop) > 0) = True Then
        
        Range("current_year").Value = Ledger_year_drop.Value
        
        month1.Caption = Format(month_1, "MMMM YYYY")

        month11.Caption = Format(month_11, "MMMM YYYY")
        month12.Caption = Format(month_12, "MMMM YYYY")


        MY_YEAR.Value = Range("current_year")
        MY_MONTH.Value = Format(WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("Months_of_the_year"), 1), "m")

    Else
    'DO NOTHING
        Exit Sub
End If

End Sub

Private Sub NextRecord_Click()
Dim x As Long
Dim y As Long
x = Ledger_reg_No.Value + 1
y = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("xreg_a1"))
If x > y Then Ledger_reg_No.Value = y Else Ledger_reg_No.Value = x
End Sub

Private Sub PrevRecord_Click()
Dim x As Long
x = Ledger_reg_No.Value - 1
If x = 0 Then Ledger_reg_No.Value = 1 Else Ledger_reg_No.Value = x
End Sub

Private Sub LastRecord_Click()
Ledger_reg_No.Value = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("xreg_a1"))
End Sub

Private Sub FirstRecord_Click()
Ledger_reg_No.Value = WorksheetFunction.Min(Range("xreg_a1"))
End Sub

VBA MACRO Print_single_ledger.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/Print_single_ledger'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Sub PDFLedger()

'for Excel 2010 and later
'checks for existing file
'prompt to overwrite or rename
'uses bFileExists Function, below

Dim wsA As Worksheet
Dim wbA As Workbook
Dim strName As String
Dim strPath As String
Dim strFile As String
Dim strPathFile As String
Dim strTime As String
Dim myFile As Variant
Dim lOver As Long
On Error GoTo errHandler

Set wbA = ActiveWorkbook
Set wsA = Sheets("Personal_Ledger")

Application.ScreenUpdating = False
strTime = Format(Now(), "yyyy_mm_dd\_hhmmss")


'get active workbook folder, if saved
strPath = wbA.Path
If strPath = "" Then
  strPath = Application.DefaultFilePath
End If
strPath = strPath & "\"

strName = wsA.Range("ALEG_NO").Value _
          & " - " & wsA.Range("ALEG_NAME").Value _
          & " - " & strTime
          
'create default name for savng file
strFile = strName & ".pdf"
strPathFile = strPath & strFile

If bFileExists(strPathFile) Then
  lOver = MsgBox("Overwrite existing file?", _
    vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "File Exists")
  If lOver <> vbYes Then
    'user can enter name and
    ' select folder for file
    myFile = Application.GetSaveAsFilename _
      (InitialFileName:=strPathFile, _
          FileFilter:="PDF Files (*.pdf), *.pdf", _
          Title:="Select Folder and FileName to save")
    If myFile <> "False" Then
      strPathFile = myFile
    Else
      GoTo exitHandler
    End If
  End If
End If

'export to PDF in current folder
wsA.ExportAsFixedFormat _
    Type:=xlTypePDF, _
    Filename:=strPathFile, _
    Quality:=xlQualityStandard, _
    IncludeDocProperties:=True, _
    IgnorePrintAreas:=False, _
    OpenAfterPublish:=True

'confirmation message with file info
MsgBox "PDF file has been created: " _
  & vbCrLf _
  & strPathFile

exitHandler:
    Exit Sub
errHandler:
    MsgBox "Could not create PDF file"
    Resume exitHandler
End Sub

'=============================
Function bFileExists(rsFullPath As String) As Boolean
  bFileExists = CBool(Len(Dir$(rsFullPath)) > 0)
End Function
'=============================

    myFile = Application.GetSaveAsFilename _
      (InitialFileName:=strPathFile, _
          FileFilter:="PDF Files (*.pdf), *.pdf", _
          Title:="Select Folder and FileName to save")
    If myFile <> "False" Then
      strPathFile = myFile
    Else
      GoTo exitHandler
    End If
  End If
End If

'export to PDF in current folder
wsA.ExportAsFixedFormat _
    Type:=xlTypePDF, _
    Filename:=strPathFile, _
    Quality:=xlQualityStandard, _
    IncludeDocProperties:=True, _
    IgnorePrintAreas:=False, _
    OpenAfterPublish:=False

exitHandler:
    Exit Sub
errHandler:
    MsgBox "Could not create PDF file"
    Resume exitHandler
End Sub

VBA MACRO Print_Unclaimed.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/Print_Unclaimed'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Sub PDFunclaimed()
'for Excel 2010 and later
'checks for existing file
'prompt to overwrite or rename
'uses bFileExists Function, below

Dim wsA As Worksheet
Dim wbA As Workbook
Dim strName As String
Dim strPath As String
Dim strFile As String
Dim strPathFile As String
Dim strTime As String
Dim myFile As Variant
Dim lOver As Long
'On Error GoTo errHandler

Set wbA = ActiveWorkbook
Set wsA = Sheets("Unclaimed_prnt")

Application.ScreenUpdating = False
strTime = Format(Now(), "yyyy_mm_dd\_hhmmss")

'get active workbook folder, if saved
strPath = wbA.Path
If strPath = "" Then
    strPath = Application.DefaultFilePath
End If
strPath = strPath & "\"

strName = "UNCLAIMED PAYMENTS (" & wsA.Range("UNCMonth").Value & "_" & wsA.Range("UNCyear").Value & ") " & strTime
          
'create default name for savng file
strFile = strName & ".pdf"
strPathFile = strPath & strFile

If bFileExists(strPathFile) Then
  lOver = MsgBox("Overwrite existing file?", _
    vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "File Exists")
  If lOver <> vbYes Then
    'user can enter name and
    ' select folder for file
    myFile = Application.GetSaveAsFilename _
      (InitialFileName:=strPathFile, _
          FileFilter:="PDF Files (*.pdf), *.pdf", _
          Title:="Select Folder and FileName to save")
    If myFile <> "False" Then
      strPathFile = myFile
    Else
      GoTo exitHandler
    End If
  End If
End If

'export to PDF in current folder
wsA.ExportAsFixedFormat _
    Type:=xlTypePDF, _
    Filename:=strPathFile, _
    Quality:=xlQualityStandard, _
    IncludeDocProperties:=True, _
    IgnorePrintAreas:=False, _
    OpenAfterPublish:=True

'confirmation message with file info
MsgBox "PDF file has been created: " _
  & vbCrLf _
  & strPathFile

exitHandler:
    Exit Sub
errHandler:
    MsgBox "Could not create PDF file"
    Resume exitHandler
End Sub

End Function

Private Sub reg_No_Change()
On Error Resume Next
If MemberDetails = True Or AdminDetails = True Then
        If AdminDetails = True Then
        
            ' Full Name Query
            Dim Special_Account_NAME As String
            
            Special_Account_NAME = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("Special_Account_NAME"), WorksheetFunction.Match(reg_No, Range("Special_Account_ID"), 0))
            tbox_srch_FullName = UCase(Special_Account_NAME)
            reg_No = UCase(reg_No)
            
            Else
        
            ' Full Name Query
            Dim Lastname As String
            Dim Firstname As String
            Dim Middlename As String
        
            Lastname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a3"), reg_No)
            Firstname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a4"), reg_No)
            Middlename = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a5"), reg_No)
            tbox_srch_FullName = Lastname + " " + Firstname + " " + Middlename
            End If
    
Else

            ' Full Name Query
            Dim xLastname As String
            Dim xFirstname As String
            Dim xMiddlename As String
        
            xLastname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a3"), reg_No)
            xFirstname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a4"), reg_No)
            xMiddlename = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a5"), reg_No)
            tbox_srch_FullName = xLastname + " " + xFirstname + " " + xMiddlename
End If

End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: loadList
' Purpose: Filter source list based on search terms
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Adebowale Abdul wasiu
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub loadList()

    Dim baseArray() As Variant
    Dim resultArray() As Variant
    Dim TranIDArray() As Variant
    Dim FullNameArray() As Variant
    Dim AmountArray() As Variant
    Dim DateArray() As Variant
    Dim DetailsArray() As Variant
    
    Dim a, b As Long
    
    Dim counter As Long, i As Long

    On Error Resume Next
    
    'Clear current list boxes
    Me.lbox_TranID.Clear
    Me.lbox_FullName.Clear
    Me.lbox_Amount.Clear
    Me.lbox_Date.Clear
    
    'Assign source list to an array, unfiltered
        baseArray = Range("Table_Remittance")
        
    'Set a default value to filter match counter
    counter = 0
    
    'Iterate through the source list, if search term is found add item to result array
    For i = LBound(baseArray) To UBound(baseArray)
        If ((InStr(1, baseArray(i, 11), Me.tbox_srch_FullName.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_TranID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Amount.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Date.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Details.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 1), Me.tbox_srch_TranID.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And Me.tbox_srch_FullName.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Amount.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Date.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Details.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 4), Me.tbox_srch_Amount.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_TranID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_FullName.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Date.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Details.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 2), Me.tbox_srch_Date.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_TranID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_FullName.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Amount.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Details.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 7), Me.tbox_srch_Details.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_TranID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_FullName.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Amount.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Date.Value = "")) Then
            
            
            counter = counter + 1
            
            ReDim Preserve resultArray(1 To 5, 1 To counter)
            resultArray(1, counter) = baseArray(i, 11)
            resultArray(2, counter) = baseArray(i, 1)
            resultArray(3, counter) = baseArray(i, 4)
            resultArray(4, counter) = baseArray(i, 2)
            resultArray(5, counter) = baseArray(i, 7)
        End If
    Next i
        
        

    'If there is at least one match, separate result array to four arrays and load them to the listboxes
    If counter > 0 Then
        ReDim FullNameArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        ReDim TranIDArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        ReDim AmountArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        ReDim DateArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        ReDim DetailsArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        
        For i = LBound(resultArray, 2) To UBound(resultArray, 2)
            FullNameArray(i, 1) = resultArray(1, i)
            TranIDArray(i, 1) = resultArray(2, i)
            AmountArray(i, 1) = resultArray(3, i)
            DateArray(i, 1) = resultArray(4, i)
            DetailsArray(i, 1) = resultArray(5, i)
        Next i
        
        
        
        Me.lbox_TranID.List = TranIDArray
        Me.lbox_FullName.List = FullNameArray
        Me.lbox_Amount.List = AmountArray
        Me.lbox_Date.List = DateArray
        Me.lbox_Details.List = DetailsArray
                
                
    End If
    
    
    ResultCount.Caption = lbox_FullName.ListCount & " Result(s) "
    
    If tbox_srch_FullName = "" Then
    ResultCount2.Caption = ""
    ResultCount3.Caption = ""
    Else
    ResultCount2.Caption = "Found For "
    ResultCount3.Caption = tbox_srch_FullName
    End If
    
        
'Format column 5 as currency
 For a = 0 To Me.lbox_Amount.ListCount - 1
 Me.lbox_Amount.List(a) = (Format(Val(Me.lbox_Amount.List(a)), "#,##0.000"))
 Next
    
    
End Sub

Private Function GetSelectedIndexs() As Boolean()
    If lbox_Amount.ListCount < 0 Then
        ReDim sel(0 To lbox_Amount.ListCount - 1) As Boolean

        Dim i As Integer
        For i = 0 To lbox_Amount.ListCount - 1
            sel(i) = lbox_Amount.Selected(i)
        Next

        GetSelectedIndexs = sel
    Else
        ReDim GetSelectedIndexs(0)
    End If
End Function

Private Function SetSelectedIndexs(sel() As Boolean)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = LBound(sel) To UBound(sel)
        lbox_Amount.Selected(i) = sel(i)
    Next
End Function
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: addItemByClick
' Purpose: Simple add word and form hide call, called in click events
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Gergely Gyetvai
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub addItemByClick()
    Call addWord
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: addWord
' Purpose: Add selected item to a cell
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Gergely Gyetvai
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub addWord()

    Dim selectedValue As Long, selectedIndex As Long
    Dim cell As TextBox

    If Me.lbox_TranID.ListIndex > -1 Then
    
        selectedIndex = Me.lbox_TranID.ListIndex
        Range("TEMPDATA") = Me.lbox_TranID.List(selectedIndex)
        
        If Isloaded("Remittance_Form") Then
            Remittance_Form.TextBox0001 = Range("TEMPDATA")
            Unload Me
            Else
            Remittance_Form.TextBox0001 = Range("TEMPDATA")
            Remittance_Form.Show
        End If
    End If
End Sub

Private Function track_status() As Boolean
Dim actv_date As Long
Dim b
Dim datelist As Range
Set datelist = Range("tSTATUSdate")

actv_date = DateSerial(Year(Now()), Range("Start_month"), Range("Grace_time"))
b = Application.WorksheetFunction.Match(actv_date, datelist, 0)

If Now >= actv_date Then
track_status = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("tSTATUS"), b)
Else
track_status = True
End If

End Function

Sub submit_data()

If rate2 = "" Then rate2 = 0

VBA MACRO IntrestTracker.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/IntrestTracker'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Private Function track_status() As Boolean
Dim actv_date As Long
Dim b
Dim datelist As Range
Set datelist = Range("tSTATUSdate")



actv_date = DateSerial(Year(Now()), Month(Now()), 25)
b = Application.WorksheetFunction.Match(actv_date, datelist, 0)

If Now >= actv_date Then
track_status = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("tSTATUS"), b)
Else
track_status = True
End If

End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: loadList
' Purpose: Filter source list based on search terms
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Adebowale Abdul wasiu
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub loadList()

    Dim baseArray() As Variant
    Dim resultArray() As Variant
    Dim IDArray() As Variant
    Dim wordArray() As Variant
    Dim MobileArray() As Variant
    Dim BussArray() As Variant
    Dim counter As Long, i As Long

    On Error Resume Next
    
    'Clear current list boxes
    Me.lbox_ID.Clear
    Me.lbox_Word.Clear
    Me.lbox_Mobile.Clear
    Me.lbox_Buss.Clear
    
    'Assign source list to an array, unfiltered
    If Reg_mem = True Then
        baseArray = Range("Table_Registration")
        
            'Set a default value to filter match counter
    counter = 0
    
    'Iterate through the source list, if search term is found add item to result array
    For i = LBound(baseArray) To UBound(baseArray)
        If ((InStr(1, baseArray(i, 1), Me.tbox_srch_ID.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And Me.tbox_srch_Word.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Mobile.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Buss.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 30), Me.tbox_srch_Word.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_ID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Mobile.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Buss.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 8), Me.tbox_srch_Mobile.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_ID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Word.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Buss.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 13), Me.tbox_srch_Buss.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_ID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Word.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Mobile.Value = "")) Then
            
            
            counter = counter + 1
            
            ReDim Preserve resultArray(1 To 4, 1 To counter)
            resultArray(1, counter) = baseArray(i, 1)
            resultArray(2, counter) = baseArray(i, 30)
            resultArray(3, counter) = baseArray(i, 8)
            resultArray(4, counter) = baseArray(i, 13)
            
        End If
    Next i
        
        
        
        
    Else
        baseArray = Range("X_REG_Table")
        
            'Set a default value to filter match counter
    counter = 0
    
    'Iterate through the source list, if search term is found add item to result array
    For i = LBound(baseArray) To UBound(baseArray)
        If ((InStr(1, baseArray(i, 1), Me.tbox_srch_ID.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And Me.tbox_srch_Word.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Mobile.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Buss.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 30), Me.tbox_srch_Word.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_ID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Mobile.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Buss.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 8), Me.tbox_srch_Mobile.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_ID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Word.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Buss.Value = "") Or _
            (InStr(1, baseArray(i, 13), Me.tbox_srch_Buss.Value, vbTextCompare) > 0 And tbox_srch_ID.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Word.Value = "" And Me.tbox_srch_Mobile.Value = "")) Then
            
            
            counter = counter + 1
            
            ReDim Preserve resultArray(1 To 4, 1 To counter)
            resultArray(1, counter) = baseArray(i, 1)
            resultArray(2, counter) = baseArray(i, 30)
            resultArray(3, counter) = baseArray(i, 8)
            resultArray(4, counter) = baseArray(i, 13)
            
        End If
    Next i
End If

    'If there is at least one match, separate result array to four arrays and load them to the listboxes
    If counter > 0 Then
        ReDim IDArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        ReDim wordArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        ReDim MobileArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        ReDim BussArray(1 To UBound(resultArray, 2), 1 To 1)
        
        For i = LBound(resultArray, 2) To UBound(resultArray, 2)
            IDArray(i, 1) = resultArray(1, i)
            wordArray(i, 1) = resultArray(2, i)
            MobileArray(i, 1) = resultArray(3, i)
            BussArray(i, 1) = resultArray(4, i)
        Next i
        
        Me.lbox_ID.List = IDArray
        Me.lbox_Word.List = wordArray
        Me.lbox_Mobile.List = MobileArray
        Me.lbox_Buss.List = BussArray
        
        
        
    End If
    
    
   ' ResultCount.Caption = lbox_Word.ListCount & " Result(s) "
    
    'If tbox_srch_Word = "" Then
    
    
    
    ResultCount2.Caption = ""
    ResultCount3.Caption = ""
   ' Else
   ' ResultCount2.Caption = "Found For "
   ' ResultCount3.Caption = tbox_srch_Word
   ' End If



    ResultCount.Caption = lbox_ID.ListCount & " Result(s) "

    
    If tbox_srch_Word <> "" Then
        ResultCount2.Caption = "Found For "
        ResultCount3.Caption = tbox_srch_Word
    ElseIf tbox_srch_ID <> "" Then
        ResultCount2.Caption = "Found For "
        ResultCount3.Caption = tbox_srch_ID
    ElseIf tbox_srch_Buss <> "" Then
        ResultCount2.Caption = "Found For "
        ResultCount3.Caption = tbox_srch_Buss
    ElseIf tbox_srch_Mobile <> "" Then
        ResultCount2.Caption = "Found For "
        ResultCount3.Caption = tbox_srch_Mobile
    Else
        ResultCount2.Caption = ""
        ResultCount3.Caption = ""
    End If
    
    
End Sub


' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: addItemByClick
' Purpose: Simple add word and form hide call, called in click events
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Gergely Gyetvai
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub addItemByClick()
    Call addWord
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: addWord
' Purpose: Add selected item to a cell
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Gergely Gyetvai
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub addWord()

    Dim selectedValue As Long, selectedIndex As Long
    Dim cell As TextBox

    If Me.lbox_ID.ListIndex > -1 Then
    
        selectedIndex = Me.lbox_ID.ListIndex
        Range("TEMPDATA") = Me.lbox_ID.List(selectedIndex)
        
        If Isloaded("Registration_form") Then
            Registration_form.TextBox0001 = Range("TEMPDATA")
            Unload Me
            Else
            Registration_form.TextBox0001 = Range("TEMPDATA")
            Registration_form.Show
        End If
    End If
End Sub

VBA MACRO Print_Schedule.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/Print_Schedule'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Sub PDFSchedule()
'for Excel 2010 and later
'checks for existing file
'prompt to overwrite or rename
'uses bFileExists Function, below

Dim wsA As Worksheet
Dim wbA As Workbook
Dim strName As String
Dim strPath As String
Dim strFile As String
Dim strPathFile As String
Dim strTime As String
Dim myFile As Variant
Dim lOver As Long
'On Error GoTo errHandler

Set wbA = ActiveWorkbook
Set wsA = Sheets("schedule_prnt")

Application.ScreenUpdating = False
strTime = Format(Now(), "yyyy_mm_dd\_hhmmss")

'get active workbook folder, if saved
strPath = wbA.Path
If strPath = "" Then
    strPath = Application.DefaultFilePath
End If
strPath = strPath & "\"

strName = "Monthly Schedule(" & wsA.Range("sdl_month").Value & "_" & wsA.Range("sdl_year").Value & " " & wsA.Range("sdl_detail").Value & ")  " & strTime
          
'create default name for savng file
strFile = strName & ".pdf"
strPathFile = strPath & strFile

If bFileExists(strPathFile) Then
  lOver = MsgBox("Overwrite existing file?", _
    vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "File Exists")
  If lOver <> vbYes Then
    'user can enter name and
    ' select folder for file
    myFile = Application.GetSaveAsFilename _
      (InitialFileName:=strPathFile, _
          FileFilter:="PDF Files (*.pdf), *.pdf", _
          Title:="Select Folder and FileName to save")
    If myFile <> "False" Then
      strPathFile = myFile
    Else
      GoTo exitHandler
    End If
  End If
End If

'export to PDF in current folder
wsA.ExportAsFixedFormat _
    Type:=xlTypePDF, _
    Filename:=strPathFile, _
    Quality:=xlQualityStandard, _
    IncludeDocProperties:=True, _
    IgnorePrintAreas:=False, _
    OpenAfterPublish:=True

'confirmation message with file info
MsgBox "PDF file has been created: " _
  & vbCrLf _
  & strPathFile

exitHandler:
    Exit Sub
errHandler:
    MsgBox "Could not create PDF file"
    Resume exitHandler
End Sub
'=============================
Function bFileExists(rsFullPath As String) As Boolean
  bFileExists = CBool(Len(Dir$(rsFullPath)) > 0)
End Function

    Dim r_cnt15 As Long, rem_m15 As Long, adv15 As Double
    If CB15 >= 0 Then adv15 = 0 Else r_cnt15 = Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_det_a2"), i, Range("rem_det_a17"), ">0"): rem_m15 = IIf(6 - r_cnt15 < 1, 1, 6 - r_cnt15): adv15 = WorksheetFunction.RoundUp((CB15 * -1) / rem_m15, 0): If adv15 > (CB15 * -1) Then adv15 = CB15 * -1

    '=======================================================================================

    exp_bal = Range("Expexted_Bal_5")

    '=======================================================================================

    Range("AdvisePrt_27").Cells(r) = Format(raw_adv25, "#,##0.000")

    '=======================================================================================

    Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r) = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -25), Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -24),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -23),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -22),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -21),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -20),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -19),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -18),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -17),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -16),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -15),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -14),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -13),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -12),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -11),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -10),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -9),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -8),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -7),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset
(0, -6),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -5),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -4),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -3),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -2),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -1)  ), "#,##0.000")

nextno:

Next i

End Sub

Sub AdviseMe_plus_names()

On Error Resume Next

Dim rgstatusLIST As Range

Dim m As Long

Dim i As Long

Dim CB1, CB2, CB3, CB4, CB5, CB6, CB7, CB8, CB9, CB10, CB11, CB12, CB13, CB14, CB15, CB16, CB17, CB18, CB19, CB20, CB21, CB22, CB23, CB24, CB25 As Double

    Dim r_cnt15 As Long, rem_m15 As Long, adv15 As Double
    If CB15 >= 0 Then adv15 = 0 Else r_cnt15 = Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_det_a2"), i, Range("rem_det_a17"), ">0"): rem_m15 = IIf(6 - r_cnt15 < 1, 1, 6 - r_cnt15): adv15 = WorksheetFunction.RoundUp((CB15 * -1) / rem_m15, 0): If adv15 > (CB15 * -1) Then adv15 = CB15 * -1

    '=======================================================================================

    Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r) = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -25), Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -24),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -23),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -22),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -21),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -20),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -19),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -18),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -17),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -16),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -15),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -14),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -13),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -12),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -11),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -10),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -9),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -8),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -7),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset
(0, -6),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -5),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -4),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -3),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -2),  Range("AdvisePrt_28").Cells(r).Offset(0, -1)  ), "#,##0.000")

VBA MACRO Print_mem_list.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/Print_mem_list'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Sub PDFmemberList()
'for Excel 2010 and later
'checks for existing file
'prompt to overwrite or rename
'uses bFileExists Function, below

Dim wsA As Worksheet
Dim wbA As Workbook
Dim strName As String
Dim strPath As String
Dim strFile As String
Dim strPathFile As String
Dim strTime As String
Dim myFile As Variant
Dim lOver As Long
'On Error GoTo errHandler

Set wbA = ActiveWorkbook
Set wsA = Sheets("Member_list")

Application.ScreenUpdating = False
strTime = Format(Now(), "yyyy_mm_dd\_hhmmss")

'get active workbook folder, if saved
strPath = wbA.Path
If strPath = "" Then
    strPath = Application.DefaultFilePath
End If
strPath = strPath & "\"

strName = "Member list " & strTime
          
'create default name for savng file
strFile = strName & ".pdf"
strPathFile = strPath & strFile

If bFileExists(strPathFile) Then
  lOver = MsgBox("Overwrite existing file?", _
    vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "File Exists")
  If lOver <> vbYes Then
    'user can enter name and
    ' select folder for file
    myFile = Application.GetSaveAsFilename _
      (InitialFileName:=strPathFile, _
          FileFilter:="PDF Files (*.pdf), *.pdf", _
          Title:="Select Folder and FileName to save")
    If myFile <> "False" Then
      strPathFile = myFile
    Else
      GoTo exitHandler
    End If
  End If
End If

'export to PDF in current folder
wsA.ExportAsFixedFormat _
    Type:=xlTypePDF, _
    Filename:=strPathFile, _
    Quality:=xlQualityStandard, _
    IncludeDocProperties:=True, _
    IgnorePrintAreas:=False, _
    OpenAfterPublish:=True

'confirmation message with file info
MsgBox "PDF file has been created: " _
  & vbCrLf _
  & strPathFile

exitHandler:
    Exit Sub
errHandler:
    MsgBox "Could not create PDF file"
    Resume exitHandler
End Sub
'=============================
Function bFileExists(rsFullPath As String) As Boolean
  bFileExists = CBool(Len(Dir$(rsFullPath)) > 0)
End Function
'=============================

'confirmation message with file info

Function existence() As Boolean
On Error Resume Next
If MemberDetails = True Then
    If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0003 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("reg_a1"), TextBox0003) > 0) Then
    existence = True
    Else
    existence = False
    End If
End If
If xdetails = True Then
    If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0003 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("xreg_a1"), TextBox0003) > 0) Then
    existence = True
    Else
    existence = False
    End If
End If
If AdminDetails = True Then
    If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0003 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Special_Account_ID"), TextBox0003) > 0) Then
    existence = True
    Else
    existence = False
    End If
End If


End Function
Function distribution_bal() As Double ' Function to calculate the balance after distribution
   On Error Resume Next
    Dim paid As Double
    Dim oinput As Double
    Dim xinput As Double
    Dim difference As Double
    
    paid = TextBox0004
    
    If MemberDetails = True Or AdminDetails = True Then
    oinput = Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(Tran1, Tran2, Tran3, Tran4, Tran5, Tran6, Tran7, Tran8, Tran9, Tran10, Tran11, Tran12, Tran13, Tran14, Tran15, Tran16, Tran17, Tran18, Tran19, Tran20, Tran21, Tran22, Tran23, Tran24, Tran25)
    distribution_bal = paid - oinput
    
    Else
    
    xinput = Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(xTran1, xTran2, xTran3, xTran4, xTran5, xTran6, xTran7, xTran8, xTran9, xTran10)
    distribution_bal = paid - xinput
    End If

End Function

    dateTracker = Now()
End Sub
