                              xTran7.Value = Format(xCA7, "#,##0.000")
                              Else
                              xTran7.Value = Format(distribution_bal, "#,##0.000")
                              Tran_total_updater = Application.WorksheetFunction.RandBetween(1, 100000000)
                              Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
                              
                          End If
                          If distribution_bal >= xCA8 Then
                              xTran8.Value = Format(xCA8, "#,##0.000")
                              Else
                              xTran8.Value = Format(distribution_bal, "#,##0.000")
                              Tran_total_updater = Application.WorksheetFunction.RandBetween(1, 100000000)
                              Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
                              
                          End If
                          If distribution_bal >= xCA5 Then
                              xTran5.Value = Format(xCA5, "#,##0.000")
                              Else
                              xTran5.Value = Format(distribution_bal, "#,##0.000")
                              Tran_total_updater = Application.WorksheetFunction.RandBetween(1, 100000000)
                              Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
                              
                          End If
                          If distribution_bal >= xCA6 Then
                              xTran6.Value = Format(xCA6, "#,##0.000")
                              Else
                              xTran6.Value = Format(distribution_bal, "#,##0.000")
                              Tran_total_updater = Application.WorksheetFunction.RandBetween(1, 100000000)
                              Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
                          
                          End If
    Exit Sub
    End If
End If


End Sub

Sub sub_advise()
'CALCULATE ADVISE
Dim RegNo As Long
Dim amt As Double
Dim Duration As Long

RegNo = TextBox0003
amt = TextBox0004
Duration = Range("Loan_duration")

''return row number''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
Dim row As Long
Dim ID As Long

Dim ID_list As Range

ID = TextBox0001

Set ID_list = Range("adv_a1")

If MemberDetails = True Then
        row = WorksheetFunction.Match(RegNo, ID_list, 0)
    End If

''return row number end'''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
If Tran10 < 0 Then Range("adv_a11").Cells(row).Value = Tran10 / Duration * -1
If Tran11 < 0 Then Range("adv_a12").Cells(row).Value = Tran11 / Duration * -1
If Tran12 < 0 Then Range("adv_a13").Cells(row).Value = Tran12 / Duration * -1
If Tran13 < 0 Then Range("adv_a14").Cells(row).Value = Tran13 / Duration * -1
If Tran14 < 0 Then Range("adv_a15").Cells(row).Value = Tran14 / Duration * -1
If Tran15 < 0 Then Range("adv_a16").Cells(row).Value = Tran15 / Duration * -1
If Tran23 < 0 Then Range("adv_a14").Cells(row).Value = Tran23 / Duration * -1



End Sub
Private Sub Submit_Botton_Click()
On Error Resume Next
If devstat Then
GoTo devops
End If
'//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
' Valdation or Constants Before submition of member transactions////////////////////////////////
'//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
If MemberDetails.Value = True Then
    
    ' check if distribution is balanced
    
        If TextBox0004 > 0 And textbox0005 <> "Internal Transfer" And distribution_bal <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "Distribution not balanced.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP - Error"
            Exit Sub
            Else
            ' DO NOTHING
        End If
    
    
    ' Check existing ID ' multiple Transactin ID validation
            Dim existingID As Long
            If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0001 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("rem_a1"), TextBox0001) > 0) = True Then
            existingID = MsgBox("Transaction Exists for this ID, would you like to overwrite existing data or information?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "AUTOCOOP - Duplicate ID")
                If existingID = vbYes Then
                ' DO NOTHING YET
                Else
                      MsgBox "Please change Transaction ID to a unique number or use the RESET FORM BOTTON."
                     Exit Sub
                End If
            End If
    'Validate Payment Channel
            If textbox0005 <> "" And WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Bank_list"), textbox0005) > 0 Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Wrong Payment Channel.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If
    ' Validate compulsary dues
            Dim comp_advise_total As Long
            Dim comp_tran_total As Long
            
            comp_advise_total = WorksheetFunction.Sum(CA1, CA23, CA19, CA17, CA20, CA16, CA21, CA22, CA18, CA6, CA2, CA4)
            comp_tran_total = WorksheetFunction.Sum(Tran1, Tran23, Tran19, Tran17, Tran20, Tran16, Tran21, Tran22, Tran18, Tran6, Tran2, Tran4)
            
            If TextBox0004 > 0 And comp_advise_total > 0 And comp_tran_total = 0 Then
            MsgBox "This Member is due for a cumpulsary due of N" & Format(comp_advise_total, "#,##0.000"), vbMsgBoxRight + vbMsgBoxHelpButton, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If
    'Enforce Internal Transfer
            If TextBox0004 = 0 Then
            textbox0005 = "Internal Transfer"
            Textbox0006 = "Internal Transfer"
            End If
            
    ' Validate destination account
            If TextBox0003 = "" Then
                MsgBox "This Transaction must be attached to an existing account." _
                & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Kindly tick the Admin botton and use the special Account ID" & _
                " Provided by the Admin if the transaction is unknown or an Adin transaction.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
                Exit Sub
            End If
    ' Validate Internal transfer discription
            If (TextBox0007 = "" Or TextBox0007.TextLength < 15) And (textbox0005 = "Internal Transfer") Then
                MsgBox "Kindly Provide a Detailed information about the above transaction not less than 15 characters.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP - Error"
                Exit Sub
                Else
                ' DO NOTHING
            End If
       
      If (Balance_tracker - Tran_Total = 0 Or Balance_tracker + Tran_Total = 0) And (textbox0005 = "Internal Transfer") And (TextBox0007 = "" Or TextBox0007.TextLength < 15) Then
                MsgBox "Kindly Provide a Detailed information about the above transaction not less than 15 characters.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP - Error"
                Exit Sub
                Else
                ' DO NOTHING
            End If
          
            
            
    ' Validate Registration No
               If existence = True Then
                ' Do Nothing yet
                Else
               MsgBox "Registration Number does not exist, Please check and try again.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP - Invalid Registration ID"
               Exit Sub
               End If
sub_advise
Call submitme



Exit Sub
End If
    
'//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
' Valdation or Constants Befor submition of Non Member transactions////////////////////////////////
'//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
If xdetails.Value = True Then
' Check existing ID
                If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0001 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("xrem_a1"), TextBox0001) > 0) = True Then
                existingID = MsgBox("Transaction Exists for this ID, would you like to overwrite existing data?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "AUTOCOOP - Duplicate ID")
                    If existingID = vbYes Then
                    ' DO NOTHING YET
                    Else
                          MsgBox "Please change Transaction ID to a unique number or use the RESET FORM BOTTON."
                         Exit Sub
                    End If
                End If
                
'Validate Payment Channel
            If textbox0005 <> "" And WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Bank_list"), textbox0005) > 0 Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Wrong Payment Channel.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If
            
' validate Credit Discription
            If Textbox0006 <> "" And WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("desc_list"), Textbox0006) > 0 Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Wrong Descrption.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If
' Validate Registration No
               If existence = True Then
                ' Do Nothing yet
                Else
               MsgBox "Registration Number does not exist, Please check and try again.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP - Invalid registration ID"
               Exit Sub
               End If
submitme
Exit Sub
End If
'//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
' Valdation or Constants Befor submition of Administrative transactions////////////////////////////////
'//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
If AdminDetails.Value = True Then
' Check existing ID
            If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0001 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("rem_a1"), TextBox0001) > 0) = True Then
            existingID = MsgBox("Transaction Exists for this ID, would you like to overwrite existing data?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "AUTOCOOP - Duplicate ID")
                If existingID = vbYes Then
                ' DO NOTHING YET
                Else
                      MsgBox "Please change Transaction ID to a unique number or use the RESET FORM BOTTON."
                     Exit Sub
                End If
            End If

'Validate Payment Channel
            If textbox0005 <> "" And WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("Bank_list"), textbox0005) > 0 Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Wrong Payment Channel.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If
            
' Validate destination account
            If TextBox0003 = "" Then
                MsgBox "This Transaction must be attached to an existing account. Kindly tick the Admin botton and use the special Account ID Provided by the Admin if the transaction is unknown or an Adin transaction.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
                Exit Sub
            End If
' validate Credit Discription
            If Textbox0006 <> "" And WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("desc_list"), Textbox0006) > 0 Then
            ' DO NOTHING
            Else
            MsgBox "Wrong Descrption.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
            Exit Sub
            End If
' Validate transaction discription
            If TextBox0007 = "" Or TextBox0007.TextLength < 15 Then
                MsgBox "Kindly Provide a Detailed information about the above transaction not less than 15 characters.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP - Invalid Amount"
                Exit Sub
                Else
                ' DO NOTHING
            End If
' Validate ID No
               If existence = True Then
                ' Do Nothing yet
                Else
               MsgBox "Adiministrative Account does not exist, Please check and try again.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP - Invalid registration ID"
               Exit Sub
               End If
submitme
Exit Sub
End If


devops:
submitme
End Sub

Sub ChangeloanStatus()
On Error Resume Next

Dim ID_count As Long
Dim ActiveLoan_ID As Long
Dim row As Long

If LoanCCTV_1 Then

' COUNTS HOW MANY OPEN TRANSACTION EXISTS IN ONE ENTERPRISE
ID_count = Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_det_a12"), "<0", Range("rem_det_a31"), "Open", Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003)
'  Return ID if only one transaction exists and return Multi ID if More than one exists
If ID_count > 1 Then
MsgBox "Multiple Loan Exist for the Enterprise."
ElseIf ID_count = 1 Then
ActiveLoan_ID = Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a1"), Range("rem_det_a12"), "<0", Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003, Range("rem_det_a31"), "Open")
End If
'  Return the row number of the current loan in remittance details
row = Application.WorksheetFunction.Match(ActiveLoan_ID, Range("rem_det_a1"))
Range("rem_det_a31").Cells(row) = "Closed"
End If



If LoanCCTV_2 Then

'  Return the row number of the current loan in remittance details
row = Application.WorksheetFunction.Match(ActiveLoan_ID, Range("rem_det_a1"))
Range("rem_det_a31").Cells(row) = "Closed"
End If



If LoanCCTV_6 Then

' COUNTS HOW MANY OPEN TRANSACTION EXISTS IN ONE ENTERPRISE
ID_count = Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIfs(Range("rem_det_a25"), "<0", Range("rem_det_a31"), "Open", Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003)
'  Return ID if only one transaction exists and return Multi ID if More than one exists
If ID_count > 1 Then
MsgBox "Multiple Loan Exist for the Enterprise."
ElseIf ID_count = 1 Then
ActiveLoan_ID = Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a1"), Range("rem_det_a25"), "<0", Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003, Range("rem_det_a31"), "Open")
End If
'  Return the row number of the current loan in remittance details
row = Application.WorksheetFunction.Match(ActiveLoan_ID, Range("rem_det_a1"))
Range("rem_det_a31").Cells(row) = "Closed"
End If






End Sub

    MsgBox "Invalid day of the month.", vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
    t1 = Day(Date)
    TextBox0002.Value = Format(DateSerial(t3, t2, t1), "[$-en-US]d-mmm-yyyy;@")
    query_ID_details
Exit Sub
End If
TextBox0002.Value = Format(DateSerial(t3, t2, t1), "[$-en-US]d-mmm-yyyy;@")
query_ID_details
End Sub

Exit Sub

End Sub

Private Sub TextBox0004_AfterUpdate()

        Textbox0006 = "Debit"
        TextBox0004.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        Else
        TextBox0004.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    End If
    
    If TextBox0004.Value = "" Then
        TextBox0004.Value = Format(0, "#,##0.000")
    End If

    AutoButton.BackColor = RGB(0, 255, 0)       '
    Else                                        'This will visually indicate if the autoBotton can be used
    AutoButton.BackColor = &H8000000F           '
    End If                                      '

    Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
    TextBox0004.Value = Format(TextBox0004, "#,##0.000")
End Sub
Private Sub TextBox0004_Change()
On Error Resume Next
    If TextBox0004.Value < 0 Then
        Textbox0006 = "Debit"
        TextBox0004.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        Else
        TextBox0004.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    End If
    
    If TextBox0004.Value < 0 Then Textbox0006 = "Debit"
    If TextBox0004.Value = 0 Then Textbox0006 = "Internal Transfer"
    If TextBox0004.Value > 0 Then Textbox0006 = "Credit"
End Sub

Private Sub CloseButton_Click()
    LogActivity "REMITTANCE_FORM_ACTION", "REMITTANCE", "", "", "Remittance form activity recorded"
On Error Resume Next
If devstat Then
    Unload Remittance_Form
    Exit Sub
End If
Dim closeme As Long
closeme = MsgBox("Any unsubmited data will be lost, will you like to proceed.", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "AUTOCOOP")
    If closeme = vbYes Then
        Unload Remittance_Form
    End If
    ThisWorkbook.Save
End Sub

Private Sub loanduration()
On Error Resume Next

End Sub

        WorksheetFunction.And(t1 < 0, WorksheetFunction.SumIf(Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003, Range("rem_det_a12")) < t1) Or _
        WorksheetFunction.And(t2 < 0, WorksheetFunction.SumIf(Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003, Range("rem_det_a13")) < t2) Or _
        WorksheetFunction.And(t3 < 0, WorksheetFunction.SumIf(Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003, Range("rem_det_a14")) < t3) Or _
        WorksheetFunction.And(t4 < 0, WorksheetFunction.SumIf(Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003, Range("rem_det_a15")) < t4) Or _
        WorksheetFunction.And(t5 < 0, WorksheetFunction.SumIf(Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003, Range("rem_det_a16")) < t5) Or _
        WorksheetFunction.And(t6 < 0, WorksheetFunction.SumIf(Range("rem_det_a2"), TextBox0003, Range("rem_det_a25")) < t6)) Then
            
            'do nothing
    Else

        If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0001 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("rem_det_a1"), TextBox0001) > 0) = True Then
            row = WorksheetFunction.Match(ID, ID_list, 0)
        Else
            row = WorksheetFunction.CountA(ID_list) + 1
        End If

        If TextBox0004 < 0 Or Tran10 < 0 Or Tran11 < 0 Or Tran12 < 0 Or Tran13 < 0 Or Tran14 < 0 Or Tran23 < 0 Then
            Range("rem_det_a31").Cells(row).Value = kkkl
        End If
    End If

ElseIf xdetails = True Then
    
        If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0001 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("xrem_a1"), TextBox0001) > 0) = True Then
            row = WorksheetFunction.Match(ID, ID_list2, 0)
        Else
            row = WorksheetFunction.CountA(ID_list2) + 1
        End If
    
    If TextBox0004 < 0 Or xTran7 < 0 Or xTran8 < 0 Then
    Range("xrem_a20").Cells(row).Value = kkkl
    End If

End If

'/////////////////////////DURATION CAPTURE//////////////////////////////////////////
Dim i As Long

If MemberDetails = True Then

    If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0001 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("rem_det_a1"), TextBox0001) > 0) = True Then
    row = WorksheetFunction.Match(ID, ID_list, 0)
    Else
    row = WorksheetFunction.CountA(ID_list) + 1
    End If

    If TextBox0004 < 0 Or Tran10 < 0 Or Tran11 < 0 Or Tran12 < 0 Or Tran13 < 0 Or Tran14 < 0 Or Tran23 < 0 Then
    
  i = Range("loan_duration")
    If i = 0 Then i = i + 1
    
    Range("rem_det_a32").Cells(row).Value = i
    
    End If

ElseIf xdetails = True Then
    If WorksheetFunction.And(TextBox0001 <> "", WorksheetFunction.CountIf(Range("xrem_a1"), TextBox0001) > 0) = True Then
    row = WorksheetFunction.Match(ID, ID_list2, 0)
    Else
    row = WorksheetFunction.CountA(ID_list2) + 1
    End If

    If TextBox0004 < 0 Or xTran7 < 0 Or xTran8 < 0 Then
  i = Range("loan_duration")
    If i = 0 Then i = i + 1
    
    Range("xrem_a19").Cells(row).Value = i
    End If
End If

'/////////////////////////INTREST RATE CAPTURE////////////////////////////////////////////////
'/////////////////////////INTREST RATE CAPTURE////////////////////////////////////////////////
'/////////////////////////INTREST RATE CAPTURE////////////////////////////////////////////////
'/////////////////////////INTREST RATE CAPTURE////////////////////////////////////////////////
'/////////////////////////INTREST RATE CAPTURE////////////////////////////////////////////////

'/////////////////////////INTREST RATE CAPTURE////////////////////////////////////////////////
' NOT APPLICABLE TO MUTREF/TMSA
    Dim ro1 As Long
    Dim xro1 As Long
    
    
    Dim intID As Long
    
    Dim ID_list11 As Range
    Dim ID_list22 As Range
    Dim regnumber As Long
        
        
    Set ID_list11 = Range("reg_a1")
    Set ID_list22 = Range("xreg_a1")
    
    regnumber = TextBox0003
    
    ro1 = WorksheetFunction.Match(regnumber, ID_list11, 0)
    xro1 = WorksheetFunction.Match(regnumber, ID_list22, 0)

Dim a As Double
Dim b As Double
Dim c As Double
Dim d As Double
Dim e As Double
Dim f As Double

a = Tran7
b = Tran8
c = Tran9
d = Tran10
e = xTran3
f = xTran4


If MemberDetails = True Then
        If Tran7 < 0 Then
                Range("reg_a56").Cells(ro1).Value = b / a

        If Tran9 < 0 Then

        End If

        End If

   y2 = Range("LOAN_SHARE").Value / 100 * Me.Tran3.Value
    If x2 < y2 Then
    Tran4.BackColor = RGB(255, 20, 0)
    Else
    Tran4.BackColor = RGB(0, 250, 0)
    End If

    amont = Tran3
    
    Reset_Distrib2
    Tran3 = amont
    
    Tran2 = Format(Range("FORM_FEE_3") * -1, "#,##0.000")
    VATamt = Range("VAT") * Range("Bank_charge") * amont
    Tran9 = Format(VATamt + Range("Bank_charge") * amont, "#,##0.000")
    
    Tran15 = Format(Range("Int_rate_3") * amont, "#,##0.000")

   Tran3.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
   Else
        Tran3.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
End If
    Tran3.Value = Format(Tran3, "#,##0.000")
    Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
Tran_Total.Caption = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(Tran1, Tran2, Tran3, Tran4, Tran5, Tran6, Tran7, Tran8, Tran9, Tran10, Tran11, Tran12, Tran13, Tran14, Tran15, Tran16, Tran17, Tran18, Tran19, Tran20, Tran21, Tran22, Tran23, Tran24, Tran25), "#,##0.000")

Private Sub Tran10_AfterUpdate()
On Error GoTo err

'- - - - - - - - - VALIDATIONS- - - - -- - - - - -
    Dim x As Double
    Dim y As Double
    ''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
    If CB4 < (Range("LOAN_SHARE") / 100) * CB3 Then                 '
    x = (100 / Range("LOAN_SHARE") * CB4) - CB10                        '
    Else                                                            ' CALCULATE MINIMUM LOAN COLECTIBLE
    x = (Range("MIN_BAL_10") * CB3) - CB10  ' minimum input         '

            Name_Label.Caption = UCase(Special_Account_NAME)
            TextBox0003 = UCase(TextBox0003)
            
            Else
        On Error Resume Next

            Firstname = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a4"), TextBox0003)
            Middlename = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a5"), TextBox0003)
            Name_Label.Caption = Lastname + " " + Firstname + " " + Middlename
            End If
    
Else

            ' Full Name Query

Function advise_live17() As Double ' ADVISE CALCULATION
Dim cur_bal As Double
Dim raw_adv As Double
Dim exp_bal As Double
Dim reg_No As Long

Dim curr_mnt_bal As Double


' THE FOLLOWING CODE WILL CALCULATE ADVISE FOR ENTERPRISE 17 (COOP DUES)

cur_bal = CB17.Value
reg_No = TextBox0003.Value
raw_adv = Application.WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("adv_a18"), reg_No)
exp_bal = Range("Expexted_Bal_1")

curr_mnt_bal = Application.WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(Range("rem_det_a19"), _
                Range("rem_det_a19"), ">0", Range("rem_det_a2"), reg_No, _
                Range("rem_det_a30"), ">=" & DateSerial(Year(TextBox0002), Month(TextBox0002), 1), _
                Range("rem_det_a30"), "<=" & WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(TextBox0002, 0))

advise_live17 = IIf(curr_mnt_bal > 0, 0, IIf(cur_bal < exp_bal, (-1 * cur_bal) - (exp_bal * -1) + raw_adv, IIf(cur_bal > raw_adv * -1, cur_bal * -1, raw_adv)))
End Function

Private Sub xTran1_AfterUpdate()
If devstat Then
GoTo devops
End If
On Error GoTo err
    '- - - - - - - - - VALIDATIONS- - - - -- - - - - -
    Dim x As Double
    Dim y As Double
    x = Range("xMIN_BAL_1")      ' minimum input
    y = Range("xMAX_BAL_1")      ' maximum input
  
    If xTran1.Value < x Or xTran1.Value > y Then
    MsgBox Range("xENT_NAME_1") & " cannot exceed " & Format(Range("xMax_BAL_1"), "#,##0.000"), vbInformation, "AUTOCOOP"
    xTran1 = 0
    End If

    '- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -- - - -
devops:
    If xTran1 = "" Then xTran1 = 0

    xTran1.Value = Format(xTran1, "#,##0.000")
    Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
    xTran_Total.Caption = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(xTran1, xTran2, xTran3, xTran4, xTran5, xTran6, xTran7, xTran8, xTran9), "#,##0.000")
    
exitme:
Exit Sub
err:

Resume exitme

End Sub

If devstat Then
GoTo devops
End If
On Error GoTo err

   '- - - - - - - - - VALIDATIONS- - - - -- - - - - -
    Dim x As Double
    Dim y As Double
    x = Range("xMIN_BAL_2")      ' minimum input
    y = xCB2 * -1                    ' maximum input
    
    
  If xTran2.Value < x Or xTran2.Value > y Then
    MsgBox Range("xENT_NAME_2") & " cannot exceed " & "current balance of:  N" & Format(y, "#,##0.000"), vbCritical, "AUTOCOOP"
    xTran2 = 0
    End If
    '- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -- - - -
devops:
If xTran2 = "" Then xTran2 = 0
    
    xTran2.Value = Format(xTran2, "#,##0.000")
    Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
    xTran_Total.Caption = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(xTran1, xTran2, xTran3, xTran4, xTran5, xTran6, xTran7, xTran8, xTran9), "#,##0.000")

Private Sub xTran3_AfterUpdate()
If devstat Then
GoTo devops
End If
On Error GoTo err

   '- - - - - - - - - VALIDATIONS- - - - -- - - - - -
    Dim x As Double
    Dim y As Double
    x = Range("xMIN_BAL_3")      ' minimum input
    y = xCB3 * -1                    ' maximum input
        
If xTran3.Value < x Then
    
    Dim a As Long
    a = MsgBox("Member currently qualify for a maximum of " & Format(x * -1, "#,##0.000") _
    & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Will you like to override this command?" _
    , vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "AUTOCOOP")
    
    If a = vbYes Then
        xTran3.Value = Format(xTran3, "#,##0.000")
    End If
    
    If a = vbNo Then
    xTran3.Value = Format(0, "#,##0.000")
    xTran3.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    Exit Sub
    End If
    
End If
    '- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -- - - -
devops:

If xTran3.Value < 0 Then
    xTran4 = Format(xTran3 * Range("xInt_rate_3"), "#,##0.000") 'THIS WILL CALCULATE THE INTREST
    xTran2 = Format(xTran3 * Range("Bank_charge"), "#,##0.000") 'THIS WILL CALCULATE THE BANK CHARGE
    xTran1 = Format(Range("xFORM_FEE_3") * -1, "#,##0.000") 'THIS WILL CALCULATE THE FORM FEE
End If

If xTran3 = "" Then xTran3 = 0
    xTran3.Value = Format(xTran3, "#,##0.000")
    Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
    xTran_Total.Caption = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(xTran1, xTran2, xTran3, xTran4, xTran5, xTran6, xTran7, xTran8, xTran9), "#,##0.000")

exitme:
Exit Sub
err:

Resume exitme

End Sub

Private Sub xTran9_AfterUpdate()
If devstat Then
GoTo devops
End If
On Error GoTo err

'- - - - - - - - - VALIDATIONS- - - - -- - - - - -
'- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -- - - -
devops:
If xTran9 = "" Then xTran9 = 0
    xTran9.Value = Format(xTran9, "#,##0.000")
    Balance_tracker = distribution_bal
    xTran_Total.Caption = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(xTran1, xTran2, xTran3, xTran4, xTran5, xTran6, xTran7, xTran8, xTran9), "#,##0.000")
   
exitme:
Exit Sub
err:
 
Resume exitme

End Sub

Private Sub Balance_tracker_Change()
On Error Resume Next
    If Balance_tracker.Value < 0 Then
        Balance_tracker.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        Else
        Balance_tracker.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    End If
        Balance_tracker.Value = Format(Balance_tracker, "#,##0.000")
End Sub

Private Sub Negative_Num_to_RED()
On Error Resume Next

Dim ctrl As Control      ' CREATE A CONTROL OBJECT.

For Each ctrl In Me.Controls

        If TypeName(ctrl) = "TextBox" Then
                    If ctrl.Value < 0 Then
                        ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
                    Else
                        ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
                    End If
        End If
Next ctrl

End Sub

'////////// This Resets the entire form to default
Sub Reset_Distrib2()
    
On Error Resume Next
    With Remittance_Form
    'Resets remittance
        .TextBox0001.Value = TextBox0001.Value
        .TextBox0002.Value = Format(DateSerial(t3, t2, t1), "[$-en-US]d-mmm-yyyy;@")
        .TextBox0003.Value = TextBox0003
        .TextBox0004.Value = Format(TextBox0004, "#,##0.000")
        .textbox0005.Value = textbox0005
        .Textbox0006.Value = Textbox0006
        .TextBox0007.Value = TextBox0007
    If MemberDetails = True Or AdminDetails = True Then
    'Resets DR/CR Column
        .Tran1.Value = 0
        .Tran2.Value = 0
        .Tran3.Value = 0
        .Tran4.Value = 0
        .Tran5.Value = 0
        .Tran6.Value = 0
        .Tran7.Value = 0
        .Tran8.Value = 0
        .Tran9.Value = 0
        .Tran10.Value = 0
        .Tran11.Value = 0
        .Tran12.Value = 0
        .Tran13.Value = 0
        .Tran14.Value = 0
        .Tran15.Value = 0
        .Tran16.Value = 0
        .Tran17.Value = 0
        .Tran18.Value = 0
        .Tran19.Value = 0
        .Tran20.Value = 0
        .Tran21.Value = 0
        .Tran22.Value = 0
        .Tran23.Value = 0
        .Tran24.Value = 0
        .Tran25.Value = 0
    End If
    If xdetails = True Then
        .xTran1.Value = 0
        .xTran2.Value = 0
        .xTran3.Value = 0
        .xTran4.Value = 0
        .xTran5.Value = 0
        .xTran6.Value = 0
        .xTran7.Value = 0
        .xTran8.Value = 0
        .xTran9.Value = 0
        .xTran10.Value = 0
    End If
    End With
    dateTracker = Now()
End Sub

If ent_holder = 2 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a4")
If ent_holder = 3 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a5")
If ent_holder = 4 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a6")
If ent_holder = 5 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a7")
If ent_holder = 6 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a8")
If ent_holder = 7 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a9")
If ent_holder = 8 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a10")
If ent_holder = 9 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a11")
If ent_holder = 10 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a12")
If ent_holder = 11 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a13")
If ent_holder = 12 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a14")
If ent_holder = 13 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a15")
If ent_holder = 14 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a16")
If ent_holder = 15 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a17")
If ent_holder = 16 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a18")
If ent_holder = 17 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a19")
If ent_holder = 18 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a20")
If ent_holder = 19 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a21")
If ent_holder = 20 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a22")
If ent_holder = 21 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a23")
If ent_holder = 22 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a24")
If ent_holder = 23 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a25")
If ent_holder = 24 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a26")
If ent_holder = 25 Then Set ent_address = Range("rem_det_a27")


End Function

Function Amount_minus_1() As Double
On Error Resume Next
Dim nowDATE As Date
Dim RegNo As Long
Dim day1 As Date
Dim day30 As Date
Dim bnkRange As Range
Dim RegRange As Range

Set bnkRange = Range("rem_det_a30")
Set RegRange = Range("rem_det_a2")
nowDATE = mnt_minus_1
RegNo = TextBox0003
day1 = DateSerial(Year(nowDATE), Month(nowDATE), 1)
day30 = WorksheetFunction.EoMonth(day1, 0)

Amount_minus_1 = WorksheetFunction.SumIfs(ent_address, ent_address, ">0", RegRange, RegNo, bnkRange, ">=" & day1, bnkRange, "<=" & day30)
End Function

Private Sub UserForm_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    If KeyCode = 27 Then
        On Error Resume Next
        Unload Me
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_KeyPress(ByVal KeyAscii As MSForms.ReturnInteger)
    If KeyAscii = 27 Then
        On Error Resume Next
        Unload Me
    End If
End Sub


Private Sub Bank_List_Change()
On Error Resume Next
reload_all_data
If Bank_List = "IMPREST" Then
debit_label.Caption = "ADMIN DEBIT RECORD"
Else
debit_label.Caption = "DEBIT"
End If

Dim bal_nce As Range

If Bank_List.ListIndex = 0 Then
    Set bal_nce = Range("ACC_1_STARTUP_BAL")
ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 1 Then
    Set bal_nce = Range("ACC_2_STARTUP_BAL")
ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 2 Then
    Set bal_nce = Range("ACC_3_STARTUP_BAL")
ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 3 Then
    Set bal_nce = Range("ACC_4_STARTUP_BAL")
ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 4 Then
    Set bal_nce = Range("ACC_5_STARTUP_BAL")
End If

Set_opening_bal.Caption = "Opening Balance for " & Bank_List & " = " & Format(bal_nce, "#,##,0.00")

End Sub

Private Sub Set_opening_bal_Click()
On Error GoTo err

Dim x As Double

        If Bank_List.ListIndex = 0 Then
            Set amt_rng = Range("ACC_1_STARTUP_BAL")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 1 Then
            Set amt_rng = Range("ACC_2_STARTUP_BAL")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 2 Then
            Set amt_rng = Range("ACC_3_STARTUP_BAL")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 3 Then
            Set amt_rng = Range("ACC_4_STARTUP_BAL")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 4 Then
            Set amt_rng = Range("ACC_5_STARTUP_BAL")
        End If

nnn:
MsgBox ""
Exit Sub
err:
Resume nnn
End Sub

Private Sub SubmitBtn_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim ctrl As Control      ' CREATE A CONTROL OBJECT.

    ' LOOP THROUGH EACH CONTROL, CHECK IF THE CONTROL IS A TEXTBOX.
    For Each ctrl In Me.Controls
        If TypeName(ctrl) = "TextBox" And ctrl.Name <> "myday" And ctrl.Name <> "mymonth" And ctrl.Name <> "myyear" Then
            If ctrl.Value = "" Then      'CLEAR THE VALUE.
                MsgBox "Blank or Null Data, Please enter a valid data. "
            Exit Sub
            End If
        End If
    Next ctrl


                myyear = Year(WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("Months_of_the_year"), 1))

Sub reload_all_data()
On Error Resume Next
capturedDR_CR
statementOFaccount
difference


On Error Resume Next
Dim ctrl As Control      ' CREATE A CONTROL OBJECT.

For Each ctrl In Me.Frame3.Controls

        If TypeName(ctrl) = "TextBox" Then
                    If ctrl.Value <> 0 Then
                        ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
                    Else
                        ctrl.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
                    End If
        End If
Next ctrl



End Sub

Sub difference()
''''''''''''''';;/PROCEDURE TO CALCULATE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN STATEMENT VALUE AND SYSTEM VALUE//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
On Error Resume Next
        DD1 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_1, 0 - CD1), "#,##0.000")
        DD2 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_2, 0 - CD2), "#,##0.000")
        DD3 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_3, 0 - CD3), "#,##0.000")
        DD4 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_4, 0 - CD4), "#,##0.000")
        DD5 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_5, 0 - CD5), "#,##0.000")
        DD6 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_6, 0 - CD6), "#,##0.000")
        DD7 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_7, 0 - CD7), "#,##0.000")
        DD8 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_8, 0 - CD8), "#,##0.000")
        DD9 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_9, 0 - CD9), "#,##0.000")
        DD10 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_10, 0 - CD10), "#,##0.000")
        DD11 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_11, 0 - CD11), "#,##0.000")
        DD12 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_12, 0 - CD12), "#,##0.000")

        DC1 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_1, 0 - CC1), "#,##0.000")
        DC2 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_2, 0 - CC2), "#,##0.000")
        DC3 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_3, 0 - CC3), "#,##0.000")
        DC4 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_4, 0 - CC4), "#,##0.000")
        DC5 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_5, 0 - CC5), "#,##0.000")
        DC6 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_6, 0 - CC6), "#,##0.000")
        DC7 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_7, 0 - CC7), "#,##0.000")
        DC8 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_8, 0 - CC8), "#,##0.000")
        DC9 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_9, 0 - CC9), "#,##0.000")
        DC10 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_10, 0 - CC10), "#,##0.000")
        DC11 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_11, 0 - CC11), "#,##0.000")
        DC12 = Format(WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_paid_12, 0 - CC12), "#,##0.000")

remittance_DR_total.Caption = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(amount_DR_1, amount_DR_2, amount_DR_3, amount_DR_4, amount_DR_5, amount_DR_6, amount_DR_7, amount_DR_8, amount_DR_9, amount_DR_10, amount_DR_11, amount_DR_12), "#,##0.000")

CCtotal.Caption = Format(Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(CC1, CC2, CC3, CC4, CC5, CC6, CC7, CC8, CC9, CC10, CC11, CC12), "#,##0.000")

Dim cr As Range

            Set cr = Range("bank1_a3")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 1 Then
            Set ID = Range("bank2_a1")
            Set dr = Range("bank2_a2")
            Set cr = Range("bank2_a3")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 2 Then
            Set ID = Range("bank3_a1")
            Set dr = Range("bank3_a2")
            Set cr = Range("bank3_a3")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 3 Then
            Set ID = Range("bank4_a1")
            Set dr = Range("bank4_a2")
            Set cr = Range("bank4_a3")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 4 Then
            Set ID = Range("bank5_a1")
            Set dr = Range("bank5_a2")
            Set cr = Range("bank5_a3")
        End If
        
        
        
actv_date = DateSerial(myyear, mymonth, 1)

Function Drec1()
On Error Resume Next
Dim actv_date As Long
Dim rwnum
Dim myy_ear
Dim mym_onth
Dim IDrng As Range
Dim Valrng As Range

        If Bank_List.ListIndex = 0 Then
            Set IDrng = Range("bank1_a1")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 1 Then
            Set IDrng = Range("bank2_a1")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 2 Then
            Set IDrng = Range("bank3_a1")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 3 Then
            Set IDrng = Range("bank4_a1")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 4 Then
            Set IDrng = Range("bank5_a1")
        End If
        
        
        If Bank_List.ListIndex = 0 Then
            Set Valrng = Range("bank1_a2")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 1 Then
            Set Valrng = Range("bank2_a2")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 2 Then
            Set Valrng = Range("bank3_a2")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 3 Then
            Set Valrng = Range("bank4_a2")
        ElseIf Bank_List.ListIndex = 4 Then
            Set Valrng = Range("bank5_a2")
        End If
        
myy_ear = Year(WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("Months_of_the_year"), 1))
mym_onth = Month(WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("Months_of_the_year"), 1))

actv_date = DateSerial(myy_ear, mym_onth, 1)

rwnum = WorksheetFunction.Match(actv_date, IDrng, 0)

Drec1 = Valrng.Cells(rwnum)

End Function

Private Sub NextRecord_Click()
On Error Resume Next
Dim i As Long
Dim y As Long
Dim n As Long

If memberProf Then
n = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("reg_a1"))
Else
n = WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("xreg_a1"))
End If

 y = TextBox0001.Value + 1

For i = y To n
    
    If memberProf Then
        If WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("reg_a2"), i) = "ACTIVE" Then
        TextBox0001 = i
        Exit Sub
        Else
        GoTo nnex
        End If
    Else
        If WorksheetFunction.Index(Range("xreg_a2"), i) = "ACTIVE" Then
        TextBox0001 = i
        Exit Sub
        Else
        GoTo nnex
        End If
    End If
    
nnex:
Next i
End Sub

Private Sub MultiPage1_Change()
    Me.Caption = member_Form_APPNAME & " - Page " & _
    MultiPage1.Value + 1 & " of " & _
    MultiPage1.Pages.count
        
        Nextbotton.Enabled = True
        Previousbotton.Enabled = True
    
    If MultiPage1.Value = MultiPage1.Pages.count - 1 Then
        Nextbotton.Enabled = False
        finishbotton.Default = True
    Else
        Me.Nextbotton.Default = True
    End If
        If MultiPage1.Value = 0 Then Previousbotton.Enabled = False
        
    If MultiPage1.Value = 1 Then
        Call get_Advise
    End If
        
        developerMODEcheck
End Sub


Sub developerMODEcheck()
    
    If dev2 = False Then
    
    
   If memberProf Then
        If Application.WorksheetFunction.Or(TextBox0001 = "", TextBox0002 = "", TextBox0003 = "", TextBox0004 = "", TextBox0008 = "", TextBox0026 = "") Then
            finishbotton.Enabled = False
            finishbotton.BackColor = &H8000000F
            Else
            finishbotton.Enabled = True
            finishbotton.BackColor = RGB(0, 255, 0)
        End If
    Else
        If Application.WorksheetFunction.Or(TextBox0001 = "", TextBox0003 = "", TextBox0004 = "", TextBox0008 = "", TextBox0026 = "", TextBox0013 = "", TextBox0014 = "", TextBox0015 = "") Then
            finishbotton.Enabled = False
            finishbotton.BackColor = &H8000000F
            Else
            finishbotton.Enabled = True
            finishbotton.BackColor = RGB(0, 255, 0)
        End If
    End If
        
        
    Else
finishbotton.Enabled = True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub TextBox0027a_AfterUpdate()
On Error Resume Next
developerMODEcheck
If TextBox0027a > 0 And TextBox0027a <= 12 Then

On Error GoTo err
TextBox0027.Value = Format(DateSerial(TextBox0027b, TextBox0027a, 1), "[$-en-US]d-mmm-yyyy;@")
ex_me:
Exit Sub
err:
TextBox0027 = ""
Resume ex_me

Else

'MsgBox TextBox0027a & "   Is not a valid Month", vbCritical, "AUTOCOOP"
TextBox0027a = ""
TextBox0027b = ""
TextBox0027 = ""

End If

End Sub
Private Sub TextBox0027b_AfterUpdate()
developerMODEcheck
On Error Resume Next
If TextBox0027b > 2000 And TextBox0027b <= 3000 Then

On Error GoTo err
TextBox0027.Value = Format(DateSerial(TextBox0027b, TextBox0027a, 1), "[$-en-US]d-mmm-yyyy;@")
ex_me:
Exit Sub
err:
TextBox0027 = ""
Resume ex_me

Else
'MsgBox TextBox0027b & "   Is not a valid Year", vbCritical, "AUTOCOOP"
TextBox0027b = ""
TextBox0027a = ""
TextBox0027 = ""
End If

End Sub

 .AddItem "Female"
 End With

 .AddItem "Male"
 .AddItem "Female"
 End With
 With TextBox0019
 .AddItem "Savings"
 .AddItem "Current"
 End With

 .AddItem "Member"
 .AddItem "Business"
 End With

    MultiPage1.Value = 0

      MultiPage1.Pages.count

in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/perf_optimizer'

Option Explicit

Public Sub EnableFastExecution()
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
End Sub

Public Sub DisableFastExecution()
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
End Sub

VBA MACRO modAuditLogger.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/modAuditLogger'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Public IsMacroRunning As Boolean

' Return path to main real-time audit CSV file
Public Function GetAuditCSVPath() As String
    Dim folderPath As String
    folderPath = ThisWorkbook.Path
    If folderPath = "" Then folderPath = "c:\Users\Qadebowale\Desktop\TMSA"
    GetAuditCSVPath = folderPath & "\tmsa_audit_log.csv"
End Function

' Return path to %TEMP% archive folder
Public Function GetAuditArchiveFolder() As String
    Dim folderPath As String
    folderPath = Environ("TEMP")
    If folderPath = "" Then folderPath = "c:\Users\Qadebowale\AppData\Local\Temp"
    folderPath = folderPath & "\TMSA_Audit_Backups"
    On Error Resume Next
    If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) = "" Then
        MkDir folderPath
    End If
    GetAuditArchiveFolder = folderPath
End Function

' Automatically Purge Old Temp Session Backups (Keep latest 30 sessions max)
Public Sub PurgeOldTempArchives(Optional ByVal KeepMaxCount As Integer = 30)
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim folderPath As String, fName As String
    Dim filesColl As New Collection
    Dim i As Long, fileToDelete As String
    
    folderPath = GetAuditArchiveFolder() & "\"
    fName = Dir(folderPath & "tmsa_audit_session_*.csv")
    
    Do While fName <> ""
        filesColl.Add fName
        fName = Dir()
    Loop
    
    If filesColl.count > KeepMaxCount Then
        For i = 1 To (filesColl.count - KeepMaxCount)
            fileToDelete = folderPath & filesColl.Item(1)
            Kill fileToDelete
            filesColl.Remove 1
        Next i
    End If
End Sub

' Core Key Event Logger (Streams to CSV in <1ms)
Public Sub LogActivity(ByVal ActionType As String, ByVal SheetName As String, ByVal RegNo As String, ByVal TransID As String, ByVal Details As String)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    Dim timeStr As String
    Dim userStr As String
    Dim compStr As String
    Dim csvFile As String
    Dim fFile As Integer
    Dim csvLine As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    
    timeStr = Format(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")
    userStr = Environ("USERNAME")
    compStr = Environ("COMPUTERNAME")
    
    ' Clean quotes and line breaks
    Details = Replace(Details, """", "'")
    Details = Replace(Details, vbCrLf, " | ")
    Details = Replace(Details, vbCr, " | ")
    Details = Replace(Details, vbLf, " | ")
    
    ' Construct CSV line
    csvLine = """" & timeStr & """,""" & userStr & """,""" & compStr & """,""" & ActionType & """,""" & SheetName & """,""" & RegNo & """,""" & TransID & """,""" & Details & """"
    
    ' 1. REAL-TIME APPEND TO DISK CSV
    csvFile = GetAuditCSVPath()
    
    If Dir(csvFile) = "" Then
        fFile = FreeFile
        Open csvFile For Output As #fFile
        Print #fFile, """Timestamp"",""User"",""Computer"",""Action_Type"",""Sheet_Name"",""Reg_No"",""Trans_ID"",""Details"""
        Close #fFile
    End If
    
    fFile = FreeFile
    Open csvFile For Append As #fFile
    Print #fFile, csvLine
    Close #fFile
    
    ' 2. APPEND TO IN-WORKBOOK AUDIT_TRAIL SHEET
    Set ws = Nothing
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("AUDIT_TRAIL")
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.count))
        ws.Name = "AUDIT_TRAIL"
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Timestamp"
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "User"
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "Computer"
        ws.Cells(1, 4).Value = "Action_Type"
        ws.Cells(1, 5).Value = "Sheet_Name"
        ws.Cells(1, 6).Value = "Reg_No"
        ws.Cells(1, 7).Value = "Trans_ID"
        ws.Cells(1, 8).Value = "Details"
        ws.Rows(1).Font.Bold = True
    End If
    
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).row + 1
    ws.Cells(lastRow, 1).Value = timeStr
    ws.Cells(lastRow, 2).Value = userStr
    ws.Cells(lastRow, 3).Value = compStr
    ws.Cells(lastRow, 4).Value = ActionType
    ws.Cells(lastRow, 5).Value = SheetName
    ws.Cells(lastRow, 6).Value = RegNo
    ws.Cells(lastRow, 7).Value = TransID
    ws.Cells(lastRow, 8).Value = Details
End Sub

' Archive Session Log to %TEMP% folder upon normal close
Public Sub ArchiveSessionLog()
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim srcFile As String
    Dim archiveFolder As String
    Dim destFile As String
    Dim fso As Object
    
    srcFile = GetAuditCSVPath()
    If Dir(srcFile) <> "" Then
        archiveFolder = GetAuditArchiveFolder()
        destFile = archiveFolder & "\tmsa_audit_session_" & Format(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhnnss") & ".csv"
        
        Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
        fso.CopyFile srcFile, destFile, True
        
        PurgeOldTempArchives 30
    End If
End Sub

|Type      |Keyword             |Description                                  |
+----------+--------------------+---------------------------------------------+
|AutoExec  |Workbook_Open       |Runs when the Excel Workbook is opened       |
|AutoExec  |Workbook_BeforeClose|Runs when the Excel Workbook is closed       |
|AutoExec  |clsbotton_Click     |Runs when the file is opened and ActiveX     |
|          |                    |objects trigger events                       |
|AutoExec  |TB_year_drop_Change |Runs when the file is opened and ActiveX     |
|          |                    |objects trigger events                       |
|Suspicious|Environ             |May read system environment variables        |
|Suspicious|Open                |May open a file                              |
|Suspicious|Write               |May write to a file (if combined with Open)  |
|Suspicious|Output              |May write to a file (if combined with Open)  |
|Suspicious|Print #             |May write to a file (if combined with Open)  |
|Suspicious|CopyFile            |May copy a file                              |
|Suspicious|Kill                |May delete a file                            |
|Suspicious|Shell               |May run an executable file or a system       |
|          |                    |command                                      |
|Suspicious|CREATE              |May execute file or a system command through |
|          |                    |WMI                                          |
|Suspicious|command             |May run PowerShell commands                  |
|Suspicious|Call                |May call a DLL using Excel 4 Macros (XLM/XLF)|
|Suspicious|MkDir               |May create a directory                       |
|Suspicious|CreateObject        |May create an OLE object                     |
|Suspicious|Shell.Application   |May run an application (if combined with     |
|          |                    |CreateObject)                                |
|Suspicious|Chr                 |May attempt to obfuscate specific strings    |
|          |                    |(use option --deobf to deobfuscate)          |
|Suspicious|SYSTEM              |May run an executable file or a system       |
|          |                    |command on a Mac (if combined with           |
|          |                    |libc.dylib)                                  |
|Suspicious|Hex Strings         |Hex-encoded strings were detected, may be    |
|          |                    |used to obfuscate strings (option --decode to|
|          |                    |see all)                                     |
|Suspicious|Base64 Strings      |Base64-encoded strings were detected, may be |
|          |                    |used to obfuscate strings (option --decode to|
|          |                    |see all)                                     |
|Hex String|znqk                |7A6E716B                                     |
|Suspicious|VBA Stomping        |VBA Stomping was detected: the VBA source    |
|          |                    |code and P-code are different, this may have |
|          |                    |been used to hide malicious code             |
+----------+--------------------+---------------------------------------------+
VBA Stomping detection is experimental: please report any false positive/negative at https://github.com/decalage2/oletools/issues
